Title: 1. Ghostbusters
description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

Title: 2. Beverly Hills Cop
description: A freewheeling Detroit cop pursuing a murder investigation finds himself dealing with the very different culture of Beverly Hills.

Title: 3. Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
description: In 1935, Indiana Jones is tasked by Indian villagers with reclaiming a sacred stone stolen from them by a secret cult.

Title: 4. Gremlins
description: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

Title: 5. The Karate Kid
description: Recently relocated from NJ to LA, Daniel becomes the target of a gang of Cobra Kai dojo students. When Mr. Miyagi saves him with expert Karate skills, Daniel convinces him to teach him to defend himself, and put his bullies in their place.

Title: 6. Police Academy
description: The mayor declares that anyone can enroll in the police academy irrespective of their physical condition or education level, and many misfits descend on the academy, including a young troublemaker who's forced to apply or go to jail.

Title: 7. Footloose
description: A big city teenager moves to a small town where Rock and Roll music and dancing have been banned by backward local parents and his rebellious spirit shakes up the populace.

Title: 8. Romancing the Stone
description: A mousy romance novelist sets off for Colombia to ransom her kidnapped sister, and soon finds herself in the middle of a dangerous adventure hunting for treasure with a mercenary rogue.

Title: 9. Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
description: Admiral Kirk and his bridge crew risk their careers stealing the decommissioned U.S.S. Enterprise to return to the restricted Genesis Planet to recover Spock's body.

Title: 10. Purple Rain
description: A young musician, tormented by an abusive situation at home, must contend with a rival singer, a burgeoning romance, and his own dissatisfied band, as his star begins to rise.

Title: 11. Splash
description: A young man is reunited with a mermaid he briefly encountered as a boy and falls in love with her without knowing her secret.

Title: 12. Amadeus
description: In 18th-century Vienna, court composer Antonio Salieri becomes awed and consumed by envy when the gifted, irreverent Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart bursts onto the imperial music scene.

Title: 13. Tightrope
description: New Orleans single dad and cop Wes Block goes after a serial rapist-killer, but when he gets too close the hunter suddenly becomes the hunted.

Title: 14. The Natural
description: A middle-aged unknown comes seemingly out of nowhere to become a legendary baseball player with almost supernatural talent.

Title: 15. Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
description: An orphaned heir raised by apes in the African jungle returns to the aristocratic society of Edwardian England.

Title: 16. Revenge of the Nerds
description: A group of bullied outcasts and misfits at Adams College resolves to fight back for their peace and self-respect.

Title: 17. 2010: The Year We Make Contact
description: A joint USA-Soviet expedition is sent to Jupiter to learn exactly what happened to the "Discovery" and its H.A.L. 9000 computer.

Title: 18. Breakin'
description: A struggling young jazz dancer meets up with two break-dancers. Together they become the sensation of the street crowds.

Title: 19. Bachelor Party
description: A soon-to-be-married man's friends throw him the ultimate bachelor party.

Title: 20. Red Dawn
description: It is the dawn of World War III. In the western mountains of America, a group of teenagers band together to defend their town, and their country, from invading Soviet forces.

Title: 21. The Terminator
description: A cyborg assassin from the future attempts to find and kill a young woman who is destined to give birth to a warrior that will lead a resistance to save humankind from extinction.

Title: 22. City Heat
description: Slick Private Investigator Mike Murphy (Burt Reynolds) and tough Police Lieutenant Speer (Clint Eastwood), once partners, now bitter enemies, reluctantly team up to investigate a murder.

Title: 23. All of Me
description: Dying millionaire Edwina Cutwater has her soul transferred into the body of younger, willing Terry Hoskins. However, something goes wrong, and she finds herself in her lawyer Roger Cobb's body - together with the lawyer.

Title: 24. Places in the Heart
description: In north Texas in the 1930s, a widow with two small children tries to save her small 40-acre farm with the help of a blind boarder and an itinerant black handyman.

Title: 25. The Killing Fields
description: A journalist is trapped in Cambodia during Pol Pot's bloody Year Zero cleansing campaign.

Title: 26. Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter
description: After being pronounced dead and taken to a morgue, Jason Voorhees spontaneously revives, escapes from the hospital, and stalks a group of friends renting a house in the countryside near Crystal Lake.

Title: 27. Dune
description: A Duke's son leads desert warriors against the galactic emperor and his father's evil nemesis to free their desert world from the emperor's rule.

Title: 28. Conan the Destroyer
description: Conan leads a ragtag group of adventurers on a quest for a princess.

Title: 29. Starman
description: A Wisconsin widow falls in love with an alien who has remade himself as a double of her husband.

Title: 30. The Last Starfighter
description: High schooler Alex Rogan conquers the Starfighter video game, only to find out it was more than just a game, it was a test, so he is transported to another planet. He has been recruited to join a team of the best starfighters.

Title: 31. Cannonball Run II
description: The original characters from "The Cannonball Run" (1981) again race across the country in various cars and trucks.

Title: 32. Teachers
description: A well meaning but burned-out high school teacher tries to maintain order against the backdrop of a pending lawsuit against his school district when it comes to light they gave a diploma to an illiterate student.

Title: 33. A Passage to India
description: Cultural mistrust and false accusations doom a friendship in British colonial India between an Indian doctor, an Englishwoman engaged to marry a city magistrate, and an English educator.

Title: 34. Protocol
description: A woman (Goldie Hawn) saves life of Emir of Ohtar (Richard Romanus) in Washington.

Title: 35. Micki + Maude
description: A bigamist must keep his wives from meeting each other, which becomes tricky when both become pregnant.

Title: 36. The Cotton Club
description: Meet the jazz musicians, dancers, owner, and guests (like gangster Dutch Schultz) of The Cotton Club in 1928-1930s Harlem.

Title: 37. A Nightmare on Elm Street
description: Teenager Nancy Thompson must uncover the dark truth concealed by her parents after she and her friends become targets of the spirit of a serial killer with a bladed glove in their dreams, in which if they die, it kills them in real life.

Title: 38. The Muppets Take Manhattan
description: Kermit and his friends go to New York City to get their musical on Broadway only to find it's a more difficult task than they anticipated.

Title: 39. The Woman in Red
description: On his way to work, Teddy spots Charlotte, an incredibly beautiful Woman in Red. He really wants to meet her, but what would his wife say?

Title: 40. Moscow on the Hudson
description: A Russian saxophonist visiting New York City with a USSR circus troupe suddenly decides to defect in Bloomingdale's.

Title: 41. The Flamingo Kid
description: A recent high-school graduate unsure of his future gets a summer job at the Flamingo beach club, and meets the charismatic Phil Brody.

Title: 42. Sixteen Candles
description: A high school girl's sixteenth birthday is anything but special, her family forgets about it while preparing for her older sister's wedding, the boy she has a crush on has a girlfriend, and she suffers from multitude of embarrassments.

Title: 43. Missing in Action
description: Colonel Braddock launches a mission deep into the jungles of Vietnam to find the POW camp that he escaped from and free the Americans still held captive there.

Title: 44. A Soldier's Story
description: A young officer investigates the murder of the strict sergeant of a platoon of black soldiers at an Army base in segregated Louisiana during World War II.

Title: 45. Against All Odds
description: A gangster hires an ex-football player to find his estranged girlfriend. When he finds her, they fall in love and things get complicated.

Title: 46. Oh, God! You Devil
description: George Burns returns as God - and as Satan. They battle over the soul of a young rock star who is willing to sell it to the devil.

Title: 47. Rhinestone
description: A country music star must turn an obnoxious New York cabbie into a singer in order to win a bet.

Title: 48. Weekend Pass
description: Three rookie sailors who have just completed basic training are out on their first weekend pass. As they hit one bar after another, they soon forget everything the Navy ever taught them.

Title: 49. Top Secret!
description: An American rock and roll singer is invited to a cultural festival in East Germany in order to distract from a plot to destroy NATO submarines, but he accidentally becomes involved in a resistance plot to rescue an imprisoned scientist.

Title: 50. Hot Dog... The Movie
description: Harkin Banks heads to skiing championships in California, and a teen runaway tags along as he parties and competes with friends and foes.

Title: 51. The NeverEnding Story
description: Bastian finds a magical book in an old bookstore that takes him on an adventure into the land of Fantasia.

Title: 52. Unfaithfully Yours
description: A composer who suspects his wife of cheating plots to kill her and frame her lover.

Title: 53. Best Defense
description: A military weapons engineer struggles to do his job responsibly, while a hapless tank commander has to live with the consequences in combat years later.

Title: 54. Blame It on Rio
description: Best friends and their daughters vacation in Rio de Janeiro only for one to fall for the other's daughter.

Title: 55. Lassiter
description: A handsome jewel thief is arrested and in order to avoid prison, must break into the heavily guarded German Embassy to steal millions in gems.

Title: 56. Angel
description: Molly, a highschooler, secretly earns her living as Angel, a prostitute whose only family and friends are the ones she works with on the streets. She has to survive against a serial killer who is targeting people of her profession.

Title: 57. Johnny Dangerously
description: Set in the 1930s, an honest, good-hearted man is forced to turn to a life of crime to finance his neurotic mother's sky-rocketing medical bills.

Title: 58. Firestarter
description: A couple who participated in a potent medical experiment gain telepathic ability and then have a child who is pyrokinetic.

Title: 59. Beat Street
description: An aspiring DJ from the South Bronx, and his best friend, a promoter, try to get into show business by exposing people in New York to hip-hop music and culture.

Title: 60. Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
description: A developer tries to bulldoze a community recreation center. The local breakdancers try to stop it.

Title: 61. Children of the Corn
description: A young couple is trapped in a remote town where a dangerous religious cult of children believes that everyone over age 18 must be killed.

Title: 62. Night of the Comet
description: A comet wipes out most of life on Earth, leaving two Valley Girls fighting against cannibal zombies and a sinister group of scientists.

Title: 63. Supergirl
description: Kara of Argo City goes undercover to retrieve the Omegahedron from a witch.

Title: 64. The Ice Pirates
description: In a distant future scarce of water, space pirates get caught after stealing ice from a spaceship. They are sold to a princess looking for her dad. He might have found a planet abundant with water.

Title: 65. The Evil That Men Do
description: A former assassin comes out of retirement to avenge the brutal murder of his friend at the hands of a sadistic torturer employed by an oppressive foreign dictatorship.

Title: 66. Irreconcilable Differences
description: A precocious little girl sues her selfish, career-driven parents for emancipation, surprising them both.

Title: 67. Dreamscape
description: A man who can enter and manipulate people's dreams is recruited by a government agency to help cure the President of the United States of his nightmares about nuclear war but stumbles upon an assassination plot.

Title: 68. Up the Creek
description: Bob McGraw is in his 12th year of college, goofing his way through life, until he has to win a river rafting race with three college buddies.

Title: 69. The River
description: A farming family battles severe storms, while taking a valiant stand against a bank foreclosure and a powerful land grabber.

Title: 70. Tank
description: Sergeant Major Zack arrives at a new army base with his wife, son and Sherman tank. One night at a bar he "stops" a pimp/deputy from beating a girl. The corrupt sheriff uses Zack's son for revenge and Zack uses his tank.

Title: 71. Falling in Love
description: Although they live married lives, two strangers keep running into each other, starting a friendship that could blossom into so much more.

Title: 72. Hard to Hold
description: A famous rock star falls in love with a child psychologist who has ears only for the classics, and has never heard of him.

Title: 73. The Wild Life
description: A high-school wrestler parties with his buddy at a swinging-singles apartment complex.

Title: 74. Broadway Danny Rose
description: A hapless talent agent attempts to reconcile a lounge singer with his mistress.

Title: 75. Where the Boys Are
description: Four college coeds, travel to Fort Lauderdale for their Easter week of Spring Break, and become involved in a series of adventures and misadventures.

Title: 76. Thief of Hearts
description: If you met Ray and Mickey Davis, you'd swear they had a perfect marriage. But if you read Mickey's diary, you'd know that unrest is lurking just beneath the surface.

Title: 77. Stop Making Sense
description: A live performance of the band Talking Heads shot over the course of three nights at Hollywood's Pantages Theater in December of 1983 and featuring their most memorable songs.

Title: 78. Terror in the Aisles
description: Horror film legends Donald Pleasence and Nancy Allen serve as the hosts and narrators for a compilation of scenes from many science fiction, crime drama, and horror movies of the 1930s through the 1980s.

Title: 79. Country
description: Farm couple Gilbert and Jewell Ivy seem to be working against the odds, producing no financial surplus. Gilbert has lost hope of ever becoming prosperous, but Jewell fights fiercely for her family.

Title: 80. Bolero
description: In the 1920s, a young woman sets out to lose her virginity. Her mission leads her to a Moroccan sheikh and a Spanish bullfighter.

Title: 81. Body Double
description: A struggling actor house-sits a luxurious home and becomes obsessed with a beautiful neighbor, and gets entangled in voyeurism, murder, and Hollywood intrigue.

Title: 82. Oxford Blues
description: A young American hustler pursues the girl of his dreams to Oxford, where he must enroll to obtain her.

Title: 83. The Bounty
description: Fed up with their Captain's harsh discipline, a sailing ship's crew decides to take action.
In a totalitarian future society, Winston Smith, whose work is re-writing history, tries to rebel. He meets a kindred spirit named Julia and they fall into a love affair.

Title: 85. Reckless
description: A motorbike riding loner rebel on the high school football team wins a date with a cute, rich cheerleader. At the high school dance, her boyfriend's behavior leads to a breakup - opening doors.

Title: 86. The Philadelphia Experiment
description: A United States Navy destroyer escort participates in a Navy "invisibility" experiment that inadvertently sends two sailors forty years into the future.

Title: 87. Streets of Fire
description: A mercenary is hired to rescue his ex-girlfriend, a singer who has been kidnapped by a motorcycle gang.

Title: 88. Just the Way You Are
description: A disabled musician thinks people treat her differently because of her disability, so she goes to a ski resort with her leg in a cast to test this theory.

Title: 89. The Little Drummer Girl
description: An American actress with a penchant for lying is forcibly recruited by Mossad, the Israeli intelligence agency, to trap a Palestinian bomber, by pretending to be the girlfriend of his dead brother.

Title: 90. Ninja III: The Domination
description: An evil ninja attempts to avenge his death from beyond the grave, by possessing an innocent woman's body.

Title: 91. Iceman
description: A prehistoric Neanderthal man found frozen in ice is revived by an arctic exploration team, who then attempt to use him for their own scientific means.

Title: 92. Hardbodies
description: A homeless beach hustler teaches middle-aged businessmen to attract women, but his scheme jeopardizes his relationship and forces a choice between easy money and genuine connection.

Title: 93. Alphabet City
description: A New York City drug dealer decides to get out of the business, but has to flee from mobsters.

Title: 94. The Pope of Greenwich Village
description: Two cousins unknowingly rob the mob and face the dangerous consequences.

Title: 95. Runaway
description: Future cop Jack Ramsay battles an evil scientist who unleashed a torrent of killer robots upon an unsuspecting city.

Title: 96. Swing Shift
description: A woman finds romance when she takes a job at an aircraft plant to help make ends meet after her husband goes off to war.

Title: 97. The Razor's Edge
description: He had everything and wanted nothing. He learned that he had nothing and wanted everything. He saved the world and then it shattered. The path to enlightenment is as sharp and narrow as a razor's edge.

Title: 98. The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai Across the 8th Dimension
description: Adventurer, brain surgeon, rock musician Buckaroo Banzai and his crime-fighting team, the Hong Kong Cavaliers, must stop evil alien invaders from the eighth dimension who are planning to conquer Earth.

Title: 99. Firstborn
description: A teenager must protect his family when his mother's sinister new boyfriend begins exerting his authority in their home.

Title: 100. Racing with the Moon
description: In 1942 California, two young men await induction into the U.S. Marines and say goodbye to their girlfriends.

Title: 101. This Is Spinal Tap
description: Spinal Tap, one of England's loudest bands, is chronicled by film director Marty DiBergi on what proves to be a fateful tour.

Title: 102. Sheena
description: Sheena grew up in the African wild, raised by a mystical witch woman. When her foster mother is framed for a murder Sheena is forced to flee, helped by her ability to talk to animals and her knowledge of the jungle.

Title: 103. The Lonely Guy
description: A writer for a greeting card company discovers the struggles and tribulations of living alone after breaking up with his unfaithful girlfriend.

Title: 104. Meatballs Part II
description: Second in the series of Meatball movies. A group of kids attempt to save a summer camp that's a financial failure.

Title: 105. Once Upon a Time in America
description: A former New York gangster returns after decades in exile, confronting the friendships, dreams, and regrets that shaped his rise from street kid to Prohibition-era mobster.

Title: 106. The Hotel New Hampshire
description: A New Englander and his odd family run a hotel in Vienna, as unexpected events change their lives forever.

Title: 107. American Dreamer
description: Frustrated housewife/writer Cathy Palmer ghostwrites a story about Rebecca Ryan, a dashing international spy, and wins a trip to Paris. While there, she is involved in an accident, and awakens in the hospital believing she IS Rebecca Ryan. Much craziness ensues as she meets the writer of the Rebecca Ryan books, thwarts real international spies, and eventually gets her memory back.

Title: 108. No Small Affair
description: 16-year-old Charles loves to photograph. A cute girl's photo ends up in his camera. He later sees the older Laura singing in a bar. He takes many more photos of her and ends seeing her again, wishing to help her career.

Title: 109. Harry & Son
description: Harry Keach has been widowed for two years and works as a demolition crane operator on a demolition crew.

Title: 110. Grandview, U.S.A.
description: With only a week left before graduation, a young dreamer itches to renounce an uninspiring scholarship, stand up to his despotic father and pursue a career in oceanography. But, has anyone ever spread his wings away from Grandview, U.S.A.?

Title: 111. C.H.U.D.
description: A bizarre series of sudden disappearances on the streets of New York City seems to point toward something unsavory living in the sewers.

Title: 112. Making the Grade
description: A spoiled rich young man hires a young hustler, who lives in a broken car and owes money to a dicey loan shark, to take his place in his elite preparatory school and graduate for him.

Title: 113. Joy of Sex
description: Convinced she's dying, a pretty high school senior sets out to lose her virginity before it's too late, and encounters a boy from her school on the same mission.

Title: 114. The Company of Wolves
description: A teenage girl in a country manor falls asleep while reading a magazine, and has a disturbing dream involving wolves prowling the woods below her bedroom window.

Title: 115. Mrs. Soffel
description: In 1901 Pittsburgh, two brothers face death row while claiming their innocence. They form a special bond with the warden's wife, who brings them comfort during their time behind bars.

Title: 116. Until September
description: A 'salt of the Earth' Missouri woman on vacation in Paris slowly gives in to the advances of a pushy--and very much married--French yuppie. Will their unconventional romance last until September, when she must return home?

Title: 117. Flashpoint
description: Two U.S. border patrolmen find a buried 20+ year old jeep in the desert with a skeleton, rifle and $800,000. They keep the money. Suddenly, the FBI shows a lot of interest in the car.

Title: 118. Blood Simple
description: The owner of a seedy small-town Texas bar discovers that one of his employees is having an affair with his wife. A chaotic chain of misunderstandings, lies, and mischief ensues after he devises a plot to have them murdered.

Title: 119. Cheech & Chong's: The Corsican Brothers
description: Superfecund twins Louis and Lucien, who can feel pain from each other's injuries, revolt against a tyrannical regent who holds France under his iron fist.

Title: 120. Exterminator 2
description: The flamethrower-wielding vigilante John Eastland returns to rid New York City of a drug lord and his gang.

Title: 121. The Brother from Another Planet
description: A mute alien with the appearance of a black human is chased by outer-space bounty hunters through the streets of Harlem.

Title: 122. Crimes of Passion
description: A mysterious woman, fashion designer by day and prostitute by night, is hounded by two men: a married father of two children, and a sexually-repressed preacher.

Title: 123. The Warrior and the Sorceress
description: A fearsome swordsman, Kain, crosses the barren wastelands and comes upon a town where two arch enemies fight incessantly for control of the town's only well.

Title: 124. Impulse
description: After a small earthquake in a tiny, quiet town, local citizens start to exhibit bizarre, violent and self-destructive behaviour.

Title: 125. Hot Moves
description: Four junior high school boys spending the summer school break in Venice, Los Angeles make a pact to lose their virginity before beginning their senior year of high school.

Title: 126. The Bear
description: Biopic about the great college football coach Paul "Bear" Bryant of the University of Alabama.

Title: 127. Under the Volcano
description: A day in the life of a self-destructive British consul in Mexico on the eve of World War II.

Title: 128. A Private Function
description: In post-World War II Britain, food rationing continues, leading a married couple to become involved in the flourishing bacon black market.

Title: 129. Silent Night, Deadly Night
description: Little Billy witnesses his parents getting killed by Santa after being warned by his senile grandpa that Santa punishes those who are naughty. Now Billy is 18 and out of the orphanage, and he has just become Santa himself.

Title: 130. Choose Me
description: Love doctor radio host Nancy, bar owner Eve, Pearl, drifter Mickey et al meet in LA.

Title: 131. Stranger Than Paradise
description: A New Yorker's life is thrown into a tailspin when his younger cousin surprise-visits him, starting a strange, unpredictable adventure.

Title: 132. Paris, Texas
description: After missing for 4 years, aimless drifter Travis Henderson wanders out of the desert and slowly begins to reconnect with his brother's family and his young son while examining his past and attempting to reconcile with his estranged wife.

Title: 133. A Sunday in the Country
description: An elderly painter whose son visits with his family on the weekends, is also surprised by a visit from his still-single daughter.

Title: 134. Electric Dreams
description: A young man buys a computer that accidentally becomes sentient and begins to turn its affections toward the man's attractive female neighbor.

Title: 135. Purple Hearts
description: In middle of the Vietnam War, a Navy surgeon and a nurse fall in love. Their affection for one another provides a striking contrast to the violence of warfare.

Title: 136. Mass Appeal
description: A popular Connecticut priest shields a seminary rebel from the wrath of a stern monsignor.

Title: 137. Heavenly Bodies
description: Single mom Samantha quits her job to open an aerobics studio. She competes with a fitness tycoon for a TV aerobics instructor role through an intense dance marathon, risking her relationship with football player Steve.

Title: 138. The Buddy System
description: A quiet school truant officer, Joe, uncovers a young boy's attempt to fake a residential address, and subsequently gets involved romantically with the boy's mother. The truant officer waffles between a sadistic relationship with his on-again, off-again girlfriend and the mother. When one of the officer's inventions takes off, he chooses the girl and shatters the friendship with the boy and his mother. Only at the last possible moment does he figure out what he's sacrificed, and attempts to get it back.

Title: 139. Body Rock
description: Chilly is just a guy from the streets with a talent for break-dancing. When his wicked moves catch the eye of an industry pro, Chilly finds his dreams of fame and fortune coming true, for better or for worse.

Title: 140. Garbo Talks
description: The son of a woman dying of a brain tumor tries to fulfill his mother's last wish: to meet Greta Garbo.

Title: 141. Finders Keepers
description: On the run from the police and a female roller derby team, scam artist Michael Rangeloff steals a coffin and boards a train, pretending to be a soldier bringing home a dead war buddy.

Title: 142. Birdy
description: After two friends return home from the Vietnam War one becomes mentally unstable and obsesses with becoming a bird.

Title: 143. Give My Regards to Broad Street
description: Paul McCartney's recording of his new album is complicated by the fact that the master tapes of his recordings are missing.

Title: 144. The Perils of Gwendoline in the Land of the Yik Yak
description: Gwendoline, a runaway nun, arrives in Hong Kong on a mission to find her father, who was last seen in the legendary Land of the Yik Yak searching for a rare butterfly. She's guided on her perilous journey by the selfish mercenary Willard.

Title: 145. The River Rat
description: After serving time for a murder he didn't commit, all Billy wants to do is to reconnect with his daughter. However, some loose ends, like the whereabouts of the stolen loot, just won't let him go.

Title: 146. Mike's Murder
description: In L.A., a young woman tries to uncover what led to the brutal murder of her old flame and who killed him.

Title: 147. Comfort and Joy
description: Alan Bird witnesses how an ice cream van is attacked and destroyed by an angry competitor. This leads him into the struggle between two Italian families, the Bernardis and the Rossis, over whose ice cream vans can sell where in Glasgow.

Title: 148. The Bostonians
description: A Boston feminist and a conservative Southern lawyer contend for the heart and mind of a beautiful and bright girl unsure of her future.

Title: 149. The Power
description: A few people come into possession of an ancient Aztec doll. However, the doll is possessed by an evil spirit, which takes over their bodies.

Title: 150. The Hit
description: Ten years after Willie Parker ratted on his old mobster friends in exchange for personal immunity, two hit men kidnap him and drive him to Paris for his planned execution. However, they encounter many mishaps along the way.

Title: 151. Songwriter
description: Doc Jenkins is a country music star who's become fed up with the industry. With some help from an old friend he attempts to right some wrongs and get back at the ruthless promoter who's swindled him.

Title: 152. Marlene
description: Retrospective on the career of enigmatic screen diva Marlene Dietrich.

Title: 153. Over the Brooklyn Bridge
description: A Jewish man who owns a Brooklyn deli asks his domineering uncle for a loan so he can buy his dream restaurant in Manhattan, but the uncle demands that he give up his Gentile girlfriend even though she's one of the few sources of stability in his somewhat chaotic life.

Title: 154. Lust in the Dust
description: A group of unscrupulous characters seek buried treasure in the old west.

Title: 155. Code Name: Wild Geese
description: Commander Robin Wesley, leader of a group of mercenaries, go to the Golden Triangle in Southeast Asia to overthrow the dictator, who is a major manufacturer and dealer of the world's opium.

Title: 156. Scandalous
description: An investigative reporter following an espionage story goes to London and gets involved with murder, scam artists and rock concerts.

Title: 157. Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
description: Warrior and pacifist Princess Nausicaä desperately struggles to prevent two warring nations from destroying themselves and their dying planet.

Title: 158. Windy City
description: The lives of a group of young Chicago men as seen through the eyes of one of them, a thirtysomething writer suffering from the early onset of midlife crisis brought on by nostalgia, his dying friend, and the wedding of his old flame.

Title: 159. The Stone Boy
description: A Midwestern farm family faces major emotional adjustment after a tragedy results in the death of an older brother.

Title: 160. Radioactive Dreams
description: Emerging from their fallout shelter after a nuclear war, two brothers fashion themselves after 1940s detectives and brave a new world of mutants and freaks.

Title: 161. Champions
description: A British steeple chase jockey who, in the late 1970s, was diagnosed with cancer. Rather than succumb to the disease, however, Bob stages a miraculous recovery and goes on to win the 1981 Grand National steeplechase on the horse Aldaniti.

Title: 162. The Bay Boy
description: A teenage boy living in a Cape Breton coal mining community during the 1930s finds himself contemplating life and is haunted by a murder he witnessed in town.

Title: 163. Razorback
description: As a vicious wild boar terrorizes the Australian outback, the husband of one of the victims is joined by a hunter and a farmer in a search for the beast.

Title: 164. Heartbreakers
description: Blue, a struggling painter, and Eli, the son of a businessman, are childhood friends who have complicated romantic relationships, which slowly expose the state of their own friendship.

Title: 165. Crackers
description: Reduced to minding the counter at a crusty pawn shop, Weslake stumbles onto a scheme by some disgruntled misfit clients to rob the place. Rather than blow the whistle, however, he insinuates himself as the heist's mastermind.

Title: 166. Repo Man
description: A young punk, recruited by a car repo agency, finds himself in pursuit of a Chevrolet Malibu with a huge, $20,000 bounty--and something otherworldly stashed in its trunk.

Title: 167. Petit Con
description: Michel is a teenager particularly ill at ease in his own skin. After an unhappy affair with a young Algerian girl and running away from home, he finally finds his balance. But he must now restore that of his parents, facing divorce.

Title: 168. Jocks
description: Two young friends tries to find a financial backer for the biggest disco party ever.

Title: 169. Almost You
description: Alex and Erica Boyer's marriage is in a crisis: Alex is bored by his job and his wife. After Erica has an accident that lands her in a wheelchair for some time, Alex meets Erica's young therapy assistant Lisa and wonders if he could start over with her. But Lisa's boyfriend senses what's going on and goes after Alex.

Title: 170. Living Los Sures
description: Diego Echeverria's documentary portrays Los Sures, a poor neighborhood in New York City, highlighting its challenges, culture, and determination to overcome racial tension and inadequate resources.

Title: 171. Tibet: A Buddhist Trilogy
description: From a portrait of the Dalai lama as a spiritual and temporal leader, to an unprecedented revelation of the mystical inner world of monastic and an unflinching depiction of the moving response to a death in the community, the film takes the viewer on a journey deep into the heart of an ancient Buddhist way of life and brings you face to face with the unbroken continuity of Tibet's unique culture.

Title: 172. The Runner
description: After enrolling in a school, an impoverished boy finds conflict with his classmates and decides to compete to earn their respect.

Title: 173. Before Stonewall
description: The history of the Gay and Lesbian community before the Stonewall riots began the major gay rights movement.

Title: 174. Tosca's Kiss
description: Retired opera singers reenact past roles at a Milan nursing home. Daniel Schmid's "Tosca's Kiss" captures their poignant performances, exploring how music's inspirational power intersects with aging.

Title: 175. Full Moon in Paris
description: Feeling suffocated by a possessive boyfriend, work and suburban life, a young woman starts spending the weekends in her Paris apartment in order to reclaim some of her lost freedom.

Title: 176. The Times of Harvey Milk
description: A documentary of the successful life, career and assassination of San Francisco's first elected openly gay city supervisor.

Title: 177. Shanghai Blues
description: During a 1937 Shanghai bombing, a soldier and a woman meet under a bridge and promise to reunite post-war. 10 years later, she's a singer who helps a country girl. The girl falls for her upstairs neighbor - the same soldier.

Title: 178. Boy Meets Girl
description: Paris at night. Alex, 22, wants to be a filmmaker. Florence, his girlfriend just left him for his best friend Thomas. First breakup, first assassination attempt. Alex tries to strangle him, but he gives up and wanders the streets.

Title: 179. Streetwise
description: Gritty documentary that looks at the lives of teenagers living on the streets of Seattle.

Title: 180. Winter Flight
description: A young RAF serviceman and a local waitress fall for each other, but Falklands War looms in the background.

Title: 181. The Toxic Avenger
description: In Tromaville, the toxic waste capital of America, a bullied young janitor in a popular gym falls into a vat of toxic waste. He turns into a super strong disfigured man, and begins cleaning up the streets from evildoers.

Title: 182. Sexmission
description: Two scientists are placed into a 3-year hibernation, but when they wake up, it turns out to have been 50 years, and they are the only two males in a new underground society composed exclusively of women.

Title: 183. Wheels on Meals
description: In Barcelona, two Chinese food truck operators must use their martial arts skills to help their private investigator friend protect a beautiful pickpocket from ruthless gangsters.

Title: 184. Fear City
description: Strippers in Manhattan are being stalked and maimed by a psycho-killer. A conflicted ex-boxer-turned-talent-manager and his business partner and friend, who represent some of the girls, set out to find him before he strikes again.

Title: 185. What Have I Done to Deserve This?
description: The vicissitudes of Gloria, a neurotic housewife, and her family's peculiar characters.

Title: 186. Special Effects
description: A director makes a movie based on a murder he committed.

Title: 187. Cloak & Dagger
description: A young boy and his imaginary friend end up on the run while in possession of a top-secret spy gadget.

Title: 188. The Return of Godzilla
description: The Japanese government suppresses news of Godzilla's resurrection as political tensions increase between the US and USSR, both of whom willing to bomb Japan to stop the monster.

Title: 189. Ghoulies
description: A young man and his girlfriend move into his parents' old mansion, where his satanic father is buried, and immediately becomes possessed by a desire to conjure and control tiny demons.

Title: 190. Screamplay
description: A detective investigating a series of murders discovers that they are similar to the slayings that occur in the new script of a Hollywood screenwriter.

Title: 191. Trancers
description: A gruff bounty hunter travels back in time to 1980s Los Angeles to stop a twisted criminal who can transform people into zombie-like creatures.

Title: 192. The Hills Have Eyes Part II
description: A group of bikers, heading to a race, become stranded in the desert and find themselves fighting off a family of inbred cannibals who live off the land.

Title: 193. Promiscuity, the Street Kids of Katia
description: A young woman cheats her impotent husband with the surrounding teenagers.

Title: 194. The Element of Crime
description: A cop in a dystopian Europe investigates a serial killings suspect using controversial methods written by his now disgraced former mentor.

Title: 195. Savage Streets
description: A teenage vigilante seeks revenge on a group of violent thugs who raped her handicapped sister and killed her best friend.

Title: 196. Another Country
description: Based on the life of the young Guy Burgess, who would become better known as one of the Cambridge Spies.

Title: 197. Conan the Future Boy: The Big Giant Robot's Resurrection
description: In the future, some humans build a spaceship to abandon earth. The spaceship crashed in an island isolated from the rest of the world. The story takes place when there are only 2 survivors in the island: Conan a boy born in the island and his grandfather. Then the world discover them.

Title: 198. Yellow Earth
description: A communist soldier travels to Shanbei to collect folk songs for propaganda while visiting a poor peasant family, giving hope to the teenage daughter in escaping an arranged marriage.

Title: 199. Love Streams
description: Two closely bound, emotionally wounded souls reunite after years apart.

Title: 200. Doraemon: Nobita's Great Adventure into the Underworld
description: Nobita requests of Doraemon the Moshimo-box and wishes for the world to become a place where the use of magic is possible. Witchcraft replaces science and technology and everyone makes use of it on their daily lives.

Title: 201. Sword of the Valiant
description: The Green Knight tricks Gawain of King Arthur's round table, then gives him one year to solve a riddle or die.

Title: 202. Secret Honor
description: A fictionalized former President Richard M. Nixon offers a solitary, stream-of-consciousness reflection on his life and political career - and the "true" reasons for the Watergate scandal and his resignation.

Title: 203. Happy Easter
description: Stephane Margelle, a successful businessman and an incorrigible ladies' man, after seeing his wife to the airport, immediately meets a young charmer. He brings her to his home, but suddenly his wife returns.

Title: 204. Nothing Left to Do but Cry
description: In the 80s, two friends misteriously wake up in the XV century and clumsly try to intermingle with the society of the time.

Title: 205. Balkan Spy
description: Convinced that his subtenant is a spy and an enemy of the state, a man falls into deep paranoia which leads to absurd and destructive chain of events.

Title: 206. They're Playing with Fire
description: A buxom college professor seduces her student to make him the fall guy in her husband's inheritance scheme, but genuine romance and a masked killer complicate matters.

Title: 207. George Stevens: A Filmmaker's Journey
description: Biography of the Academy Award winning director including dramatic color footage of WWII.

Title: 208. The Initiation
description: An amnesiac sorority member who has been plagued by a recurring nightmare is stalked alongside other coeds by a killer in a deserted department store where they are completing a hazing ritual.

Title: 209. The Public Woman
description: A novice actress's reality blurs when a Czech director in Paris casts her in a Dostoyevsky adaptation, then uses her to pose as a dead woman to manipulate another Czech immigrant into assassination.

Title: 210. Sole Survivor
description: The lone survivor of a plane crash is haunted by feeling unworthy to have survived. Dead people start coming after her to collect her.

Title: 211. The Dark Side of Love
description: The sexual relationship between a successful woman and her brother: an introvert, hypochondriacal youth, who is also a pornophile.

Title: 212. Rats: Night of Terror
description: In a post-apocalyptic Earth, where most of humanity lives underground, a group of surface people stumble upon an abandoned lab that was trying to bring life back to the earth's surface, but the place is overrun by vicious rats.

Title: 213. Sharaabi
description: A workaholic businessman neglects his only son after his wife's death. The son grows up to be a rebellious alcoholic.

Title: 214. Silent Madness
description: A criminally-insane man is accidentally released from a mental hospital. The staff tries to cover it up, but a young psychiatrist travels to the college town where he committed several murders to warn the locals and await his arrival.

Title: 215. Ellie
description: After witnessing her evil stepmother and her three lecherous sons murder her father, Ellie plots to do them in with the only weapon she has: her body.

Title: 216. Repentance
description: Varlam, the despotic mayor of a small town, dies. After his funeral, his body is repeatedly unearthed and buried again. Through flashbacks and dreamlike scenes, we witness his rise, power and ambiguities.

Title: 217. Poppers
description: A guy named Santos is released from prison after having killed his best friend. The dead friends father then organizes a manhunt to kill Santos. Santos escapes and then turns things around as he starts hunting the hunters.

Title: 218. Twenty Years Later
description: A filmmaker returns to Northeast Brazil after twenty years to resume his film (a profile of assassinated peasant leader João Pedro Teixeira) which was shut down by a right-wing military coup in 1964.

Title: 219. My New Partner
description: A moderately corrupt veteran policeman teaches the art of bribes to his young partner. The rookie turns out to be an extremely capable student, and soon overtakes the teacher.

Title: 220. Carmen
description: In 1820s Spain the soldier Don José falls in love with the fiery and charismatic factory worker Carmen. Conflicts and grievances multiply, however, as it becomes apparent their views on love and commitment are fundamentally incompatible.

Title: 221. Wanderers of the Desert
description: A teacher is assigned to a remote desert village that is obsessed with a mysterious buried treasure and whose children are cursed to wander the desert.

Title: 222. El sinvergüenza
description: Ramón is married, but has a secret relationship with Carmen. When she becomes suspicious, he makes her believe that the other family belongs to his friend, who is forced to participate in the lie.

Title: 223. A Summer at Grandpa's
description: A coming-of-age story about a young brother and sister who spend a pivotal summer in the country with their grandparents.

Title: 224. Firar
description: Details the struggles of an oppressed woman's sexual frustrations.

Title: 225. When the Tenth Month Comes
description: Duyen faces a daily struggle to care for her young son and her weakened father-in-law, while keeping secret the fact that her husband died in a battle during the war.

Title: 226. Memórias do Cárcere
description: Graciliano Ramos' period he spent in prison after being considered a subversive element by the government.

Title: 227. Nun in Rope Hell
description: After being caught in a tryst with a lover a woman decides to retire to a nunnery. Once there she discovers that the nuns and a priest are planning to engage in a number of bondage and discipline orgies.

Title: 228. Bloodbath at the House of Death
description: Six scientists investigate a strange phenomenon at the creepy Headstone Manor, the site of a mysterious massacre years earlier that took the lives of 18 guests in one night.

Title: 229. Love Scenes
description: An acclaimed actress makes an erotically-charged movie with her director husband, during which she has an affair with her arrogant co-star and he clashes with his diva screenwriter.

Title: 230. Maria's Lovers
description: At the end of WWII, Ivan returns home to Pennsylvania from the nightmares of a brutal Japanese POW camp, to his childhood friend, Maria. But he has rivals for her love.

Title: 231. Ronia: The Robber's Daughter
description: Ronja, the only child of robber chief Mattis must learn to survive the dangers of her local wilderness. In secret she also befriends Birk, the son of a rivaling robber Borka.

Title: 232. The Annunciation
description: When Adam and Eve, having succumbed to Lucifer's temptation, are expelled from the Garden of Eden, Adam makes Lucifer keep his promise. Lucifer then grants Adam a dream of the world to come.

Title: 233. Emmanuelle IV
description: In order to escape from her former lover Marc, Sylvia goes to Brazil where Dr. Santamo transforms her into the beautiful Emmanuelle. With this new identity comes a sexual awakening which is complicated by her memories of Marc. As with other entries in this series, the plot twists provide ample opportunities to expose the characters.

Title: 234. Virgin People
description: In this story, three sisters are raised in a world where men are metaphorically and literally serpents of temptation by their God-fearing father. The girls are educated enough to read from the Bible.

Title: 235. Year of the Jellyfish
description: Chris, a sexy teenager who appears mostly bare-breasted on the French Riviera, has a crush on Romain, her mother's lover. In reaction to her inability to attract his attention, she experiments with other risque affairs.

Title: 236. Maladonna
description: Maria, both rich and bored, is searching for a more exciting sex life.

Title: 237. The Lost Empire
description: Long-legged women warriors dress lightly on the island of evil Dr. Sin Do.

Title: 238. Double Trouble
description: A jazz musician and a stunt man are the spitting image of two millionaire brothers. They take the job to replace them in Rio de Janeiro when someone plans to assassinate them.

Title: 239. Christina
description: The world's most notorious heiress and bachelorette is kidnapped from the Italian countryside. Will she survive the ordeal?

Title: 240. Lady Libertine
description: Tale of erotic romance in turn of the century England.

Title: 241. The Mutilator
description: A college student, who accidentally killed his mother as a child, decides to take his friends to his father's fishing cabin during fall break, not knowing that his crazed father is stalking the place.

Title: 242. Out of Control
description: Eight teens' graduation trip goes awry when their seaplane crashes on a deserted isle. Stranded, they soon face a deadly threat from drug smugglers using the island.

Title: 243. Malombra
description: Gothic and erotic mystery about a young man called Marco, who goes to stay with his strange uncle, whose wife (Marco's beautiful aunt) died some time ago. His uncle's sister-in-law is the only other person living there. Marco spies on rituals of self-gratification performed every night by a red-headed woman who looks just like his dead aunt! Marco begins to wonder if the woman is actually the sister-in-law made up to look like her dead sister, or the dead aunt haunting the place...

Title: 244. Herzklopfen
description: The passionate love relationship between an apprentice and a student from a middle-class house.

Title: 245. City Limits
description: A pair of teenage motorcycle gangs maintain an uneasy truce between each other in the not-too-distant future. When an evil corporation tries to take over their ruined city, the gangs must decide whether to fight their common enemy.

Title: 246. Buster's World
description: Buster is an aspiring magician battling his status as a geek. Making things more difficult is his small size. This movie chronicles Buster's unique way of dealing with bullies, school, his first job and girls.

Title: 247. Ordeal by Innocence
description: Dr Calgary returns home from an expedition and goes looking for a hitchhiker whom he gave a lift to two years previously in order to return the man's address book. He discovers the man has been executed for his mother's murder.

Title: 248. Toy Soldiers
description: While on a vacation in Central America, some American teenagers are kidnapped by terrorists. A rescue mission is sent after them, but they manage to escape and join up with a mercenary fighting the terrorists.

Title: 249. Mutant
description: Two brothers discover that the residents of a small Southern town are being infected by a form of toxic waste, turning them into blood-ravenous zombies.

Title: 250. Sexo, Sexo
description: In São Paulo, the idle best friends Carlos and Nico find a job working in the garage of Mr. Jacinto. When Mr. Jacinto sees the pothead Carlos smoking grass, he tells that he would call the police. Carlos hits him violently and flees with Nico, but Mr. Jacinto dies and Carlos becomes an outlaw. Carlos decides to rob pedestrians using a robbed car. When the prostitutes Monica and her friend have an argument with their pimp Cesar in a night-club, Carlos and Nico start conversation with the women and they spend the night together in a motel. Sooner Carlos plans bigger heists with Nico and Monica becomes his mistress. One day Carlos decides to rob a large amount with Nico and he needs another partner. Monica suggests Cesar and he accepts to participate in the heist. Carlos accidentally witnesses Monica and Cesar having sex and he realizes that he will be betrayed.

Title: 251. Cut and Run
description: A reporter and a cameraman connect a Jonestown cultist and a TV producer's missing son to a South American drug war, where cartels are being massacred by cannibals and a skilled assassin.

Title: 252. Jays in the Head
description: Mato, a small-town boy, prefers fishing with friend Robo over soccer his father wants. He develops romantic feelings for classmate Terka and dreams of running away from family troubles and his critical surroundings.

Title: 253. Murder-Rock: Dancing Death
description: The owner of a prestigious New York ballet school teams up with a male model to solve a series of bizarre murders of a few of the students.

Title: 254. Violated
description: An actress in New York City goes against a group of gangsters who are abusing her "party girl" friends.

Title: 255. Night Patrol
description: A hapless police officer is transferred to the night shift even as he clandestinely pursues a career as a stand up comedian.

Title: 256. Cal
description: A young man fraught with guilt longs to defect from the Irish Republican Army (IRA). He is drawn to the widow of a slain Protestant policeman but must hide his secret that he was involved in her husband's murder and evade the authorities.

Title: 257. She
description: In a post-apocalyptic America, She, a fierce warrior who leads a women's cult, teams up with two brothers searching for their kidnapped sister. They come across weird cults before standing against the odds to defeat the evil Norks.

Title: 258. Forbidden
description: A German aristocrat falls for a Jewish man at the beginning of WWII. She joins the German Resistance to help Jews escape from the Nazis while hiding her lover in her apartment. This real-life hide-and-seek game has high stakes.

Title: 259. Strangler vs. Strangler
description: A delusional florist must peddle carnations in the city when an urge to strangle rejecting women takes over, but a frustrated inspector threatens his capture, all while a rock musician turns the panic into hit music.

Title: 260. The Dungeonmaster
description: A demonic wizard challenges a computer genius to a battle of technology vs. sorcery, with the programmer's girlfriend as the prize.

Title: 261. Dog Day
description: A fugitive on the run from the law, and carrying several million dollars, hides out in the home of a farm family. The tables turn when the family proves to be even more criminally oriented than he is--and begins to terrorize him instead of the other way around.

Title: 262. Combat Shock
description: A dangerously disturbed Vietnam veteran struggles with life 15 years after his return home, and slowly falls into insanity from his gritty urban lifestyle.

Title: 263. La silla vacía
description: A story of actors' struggles before success, a desperate father's descent into corruption due to need, and children's love leading them to follow their parents' career paths.

Title: 264. Hell Behind the Bars
description: A woman murders her boyfriend and steals some diamonds he has smuggled. She gets found out though, and locked in a prison with an evil, sadistic bisexual warden. She sets about planning her escape with some of her fellow inmates.

Title: 265. Hyperspace
description: Because of a small navigation mistake Lord Buckethead lands on earth instead of "in a galaxy far, far away". But he is still looking for the princess and the secret transmissions.

Title: 266. Swann in Love
description: In Belle Époque Paris, a 19th century Parisian aristocrat (Jeremy Irons) falls in love with a lower-class prostitute (Ornella Muti) who seduces him but never loves him.

Title: 267. Heroes Shed No Tears
description: The Thai government hires a group of Chinese mercenaries to capture a powerful drug lord from the Golden Triangle. The mercenaries manage to capture the drug lord, but soon find themselves pursued by his forces, and the forces of a bitter Thai officer. The Chinese mercenaries are vastly outnumbered, and as their numbers begin to dwindle, their desperation pulls them into a corner as their enemies close in on them.

Title: 268. The Day of the Bricklayers
description: At the local construction site, love and drama go hand in hand. Action, comedy, drama and sex are all in the mix in this very sexy/comedy starring some of the icons of this "sexy era" of the Mexican cinema.

Title: 269. Darlings!
description: A peaceful family-life is suddenly disturbed when the children enter puberty. The children take over the house and ban their parents from their lives.

Title: 270. Devil Fish
description: A marine biologist, a dolphin trainer, a scientist and a sheriff try to hunt down a monstrous shark-octopus hybrid that is devouring swimmers and fishermen off a south Florida coast.

Title: 271. Don't Open Till Christmas
description: Somebody with very little Christmas spirit is killing anyone in a Santa suit one London holiday season, and Scotland Yard has to stop him before he makes his exploits an annual tradition.

Title: 272. Lola's Secret
description: A young lad's dreams come true when his family's sexy new maid seduces him, but she also has a secret that leads to trouble.

Title: 273. The Story of O 2
description: James Pembroke, a powerful industrialist, has become a nuisance to his rivals. That is the reason why they have decided to neutralize him. To this end they call on O, who has turned from victim to dominatrix. Her mission is to compromise not only James in person but his whole family as well. And to tell the truth, O does not find much resistance on her way...

Title: 274. The Elusive Summer of '68
description: For the young man who lives in Serbian province town, the maturing coincides with the turbulent political events of the year 1968.

Title: 275. Alley Cat
description: A martial artist stops a street gang from stealing her car, but her grandmother ends up being killed by the same gang. She witnesses firsthand how corrupt and inept law enforcement is, and decides to take matters into her own hands.

Title: 276. Splatter University
description: A sociology instructor finds her new teaching duties at a private college interrupted by the presence of a killer mental hospital patient.

Title: 277. A Breed Apart
description: A conservationist and a widow meet a mountain climber hired to steal bald-eagle eggs.

Title: 278. Ciske the Rat
description: A poor 11-year-old schoolboy with a heart of gold grows up in 1930s Amsterdam.

Title: 279. Too Scared to Scream
description: A killer is brutally attacking several tenants that live in a high rise apartment building in New York City.

Title: 280. Where the Green Ants Dream
description: A geologist employed by an Australian mining company finds himself disputing the rights of some aborigines who believe their land to be sacred.

Title: 281. Old Enough
description: Twelve-year-old Lonnie Sloan is a well-to-do New York rich kid and Karen Bruckner is the more ordinary, impoverished New York kid. They happen to meet one day on the street in their neighborhood and hit it off.

Title: 282. The Holy Innocents
description: Spain, 1960s. The family of poor farmers work hard in the countryside for the rich landowners who exploit them.

Title: 283. Voyage of the Rock Aliens
description: Aliens land in the town of "Speelburgh" searching for the source of rock & roll. They find trouble with Dee Dee, Frankie and the pack.

Title: 284. The Judge's Wife
description: Paz and Miguel's marriage is disrupted by Miguel's move to Logroño, leading to a crisis of passion. Paz starts a romantic relationship with 16-year-old Alfredo, but their neighbor Martial blackmails her.

Title: 285. Macross: Do You Remember Love?
description: Earth braces for an invasion of the Zentradi.

Title: 286. Nothing Lasts Forever
description: An artist fails a test and is required to direct traffic in New York City's Holland Tunnel. He winds up falling in love with a beautiful woman, after he takes a trip to the moon on a Lunar Cruiser.

Title: 287. Abnormal Family
description: A woman's growing connection with her new family takes unexpected turns, while her spouse leads a double life exploring taboo desires.

Title: 288. The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
description: Mongols with the help of an insider, ambush the influential Yang Family, defenders of the dynasty. The Mongols must hunt down all Yang survivors so their insidious plot to overthrow the dynasty will not be uncovered.

Title: 289. Pedro Navaja
description: Based on the international hit song, 'Pedro Navaja (Peter the Knife)' is the story of the coolest street-smart hustler ever to walk the streets of Mexico City. The police are after him, his rivals are after him, and all the while the most beautiful women of Mexico are in the cup of his hand.

Title: 290. Blind Date
description: Jon Ratcliff goes blind, but doctors fit him with a device that lets him see with computer interface. His path converges with a taxi driver who performs fatal surgery on women.

Title: 291. Kaos
description: Five stories by Luigi Pirandello set in turn-of-the-century Italy.

Title: 292. Roadhouse 66
description: An ex-rock and roll star teams up with a naive young man to set things right in a small town where the local thugs rule unchallenged.

Title: 293. Mermaid Legend
description: A woman is avenging the death of her husband in this slightly supernatural drama.

Title: 294. Long Arm of the Law
description: Four men sneak into Hong Kong to rob a jewelry store. Before the robbery, they're hired by a local triad to kill a man, who turns out to be a cop. They have to execute the heist while hiding from the police hunting them down.

Title: 295. Scream for Help
description: A teenage girl becomes paranoid that her stepfather is trying to murder her wealthy mother. She tries to convince people, but without evidence no one would believe her, so she starts trailing her stepdad to prove his sinister intentions.

Title: 296. Utsav
description: In ancient India, a courtesan falls for a married but poor man while evading a royal pursuer. Their forbidden romance intertwines with political intrigue when he aids an escaped prince, leading to false accusations and a fight for justice.

Title: 297. The Surrogate
description: Stuck in a sexless marriage, a frustrated well-to-do couple agrees to see a female sex therapist. Unfortunately, she only helps escalate the tensions between them. Meanwhile, the police are baffled by a string of brutal nightly killings.

Title: 298. What Waits Below
description: An army experiment in submarine communications falls foul of the deadly secret hidden deep within the cave system housing their transmitter.

Title: 299. Desperate Teenage Lovedolls
description: The rise and fall of an all-girl punk rock band in Hollywood in the 1980s.

Title: 300. Night Has a Thousand Desires
description: A telepathic nightclub act becomes the backdrop for murder.

Title: 301. Ghost Warrior
description: A deep-frozen 400-year-old samurai is shipped to Los Angeles, where he comes back to life. Dazed and confused, he goes on a rampage. Can the female scientist and her colleague who revived him stop him before it's too late?

Title: 302. Hanna D.: The Girl from Vondel Park
description: A young street girl from Amsterdam seeks a new life away from prostitution.

Title: 303. Hard Rock Zombies
description: A freshly-out-of-the-grave band of Hard Rock Zombies is thirsting to take their sweet revenge, as they give the performance of a lifetime.

Title: 304. No Time for Tears: The Bachmeier Case
description: A mother shoots the murderer of her daughter in the courtroom.

Title: 305. The Naked Face
description: A Chicago psychoanalyst's patient and secretary are murdered and he becomes the police's prime suspect despite his claims that someone is trying to frame him.

Title: 306. The Sexual Story of O
description: Odile, a young woman looking for adventure, is seduced by her neighbors, but the titillating new game turns dangerous when two unsavory players enter the mix.

Title: 307. UFOria
description: Sheldon, a drifter and conman, visits an old friend who's been scamming gullible locals by pretending to be a preacher, while fencing stolen cars. He starts a relationship with a lonely cashier at the supermarket, who believes in UFOs.

Title: 308. Rocktober Blood
description: A crazed rock singer returns from the dead to murder members of his former band.

Title: 309. The Party Animal
description: A farm boy arrives at college determined to lose his virginity, but has no luck with women... until he discovers the secret formula to the most powerful aphrodesiac in the world and becomes the party animal.

Title: 310. Zombie Island Massacre
description: Americans on vacation in the Caribbean take a tour of a nearby island at night and watch a local voodoo ritual. Soon after, they find themselves stranded on the island and under attack by unseen foes. One by one they meet violent ends.

Title: 311. Blastfighter
description: A former policeman sets out to unleash violent vengeance upon deer poachers when they rape and kill his long lost daughter.

Title: 312. White Fire
description: Two Russian siblings living in Istanbul, Turkey, who work in the diamond fencing business, scheme to steal the newly discovered legendary diamond White Fire, but their rivals have other plans in mind.

Title: 313. Voyage to Cythera
description: An old communist returns to Greece after 32 years in the Soviet Union. However, things aren't the way he had hoped for.

Title: 314. Ya nunca más
description: A young teenage boy with a zest for sports and singing is seriously injured in a motorcycle accident. The story revolves around his shock at the way his life has changed and his difficulty in coping with his new reality. The boy, played by Latin singing star Luis Miguel at age 14, sings several songs in the movie.

Title: 315. Warriors of the Year 2072
description: In 2072 Rome, Italy, the ruthless CEO of a TV network plots to stage a modern series of gladiator games for ratings while one 'contenstant' learns of a conspiracy behind the true nature of the results.

Title: 316. Heart of the Stag
description: Chilling story of a farmhand who realizes his popular boss has been committing incest with his daughter for years.

Title: 317. Decoder
description: A noise enthusiast discovers that by changing the background music from pleasantly calming to industrial "noise" music, he can incite riots and a revolution against the looming power of the government.

Title: 318. Hollywood Hot Tubs
description: A young man gets a job repairing hot tubs for the rich and famous in Tinseltown, thanks to his parents. As he moves from one bubbly tub to the next, sexual situations change accordingly.

Title: 319. Twist and Shout
description: Denmark, 1963: Teenagers Bjørn and Erik are into girls and being in a band helps Bjørn meet Anna. Erik likes Kirsten but she likes Bjørn. Having a mentally ill mom at home also ruins Erik's chances. Anna's pregnancy changes everything.

Title: 320. Camila
description: In 1840's Buenos Aires, Argentina, a beautiful young socialite named Camila falls in love with Ladislao, a Jesuit priest. After several failed attempts at fighting his own feelings, he ultimately succumbs to her. The two later escape to a far off, secluded village where they assume new identities as husband and wife and begin running a children's school. After several months of relative happiness, the couple's identity is discovered by a local priest. Under moralistic pressure from both Camila's family and the Catholic church the authorities apprehend the lovers, and imprison them for sacrilege.

Title: 321. Shake, Rattle & Roll
description: Filipino horror anthology in three parts.

Title: 322. Lovelines
description: Greed, lust, dirty tricks and bloody fist fights... All those things that make life worth living. When Piper and Rick, the two hottest properties in the Battle of the Bands want to make it, only one thing stands in their way. They're from opposing high schools and Malibu High's 6'6" muscle-bound monster Godzilla is going to do everything and anything stop his sweet little sister getting it on with some jerk from the Coldwater Canyon High. When all else fails, only Lovelines answering service can keep them together.

Title: 323. Our History
description: A desperate alcoholic reaches a turning-point in his life when he meets a strange woman in a railway carriage: they make love, but then she leaves. Chasing after the girl, he clings to her as if she were his final chance.

description: Near the end of the 20th century, WMDs (weapons of mass destruction) are retired. However, certain factions plan to use a science space station as a weapon against each other. The astronauts inside will decide the world's fate.

Title: 325. Second Time Lucky
description: There's a new wager between Heaven and Hell: the Devil bets God that if He picked two young people to be the new Adam and Eve, they'd sin again. God accepts and sends a college couple to various eras, starting with the Garden of Eden.

description: The young, pretty and shy Angela Duvall is jailed for murder in a Brazilian prison. Whilst there she is brutally "initiated" by the other inmates. The nice, honest and handsome prison doctor believes she's innocent and tries to help her.

Title: 328. The Ark of the Sun God
description: A safecracker takes a job where he must go to Istanbul and steal a scepter that once belonged to the god Gilgamesh but is now in the temple of a secret cult.

Title: 329. The Dog Who Stopped the War
description: During Christmas holidays, the children of a small village split themselves into two groups and begin preparing a week-long snowball war. The rivalry opens up tension among group members, especially leaders Luc and Sophie.

description: It tells two simultaneous stories: that of Hermenegildo, a chemist in love with a widow with three daughters, and that of the friendly and obese Renato, a musician who works as a private detective.

Title: 331. Jungle Warriors
description: A group of models fly into the jungle of some South American country to look for a photo location. Their plane is shot down and they are captured by a drug baron's private army. At the same time, the Mafia's representative arrive to negotiate future collaboration.

Title: 332. Grace Quigley
description: An elderly NYC woman who witnesses a hitman's murder blackmails him to kill her - but first wants him to eliminate some of her friends.

Title: 333. The Chick's Ability
description: Woman has to choose between being a prostitute or posing nude for a painter, in order to finance an expensive surgery for her son, his only chance to survive.

Title: 334. Caligula's Slaves
description: Young, sadistic and uncharacteristically introspective Caligula falls for a black slave girl who serves as exotic dancer at his court, but she's secretly working for his cousin, who plans to overthrow him. Will love conquer all?

When Chia finds out, he confronts the troupe, resulting them in keeping a distance from each other. However, the troupe's troubles worsen when their opera stage is haunted by a mischievous and restless ghost (Yuet Sang Chin).

description: 1934 in Prague in Czechoslovakia, several children set forth to save the shipwrecked passengers who are on brash ice in the Arctic Ocean.

description: Federico, a talented Spanish TV executive, suspects his wife Elena, a retired actress, is having an affair. She sighs, watches the sky, and tracks a once-in-a-century comet-awaiting her "most beautiful night."

description: A kid is hypnotized by a scientist to kill his parents and ends in a mental institution. As a grown up he returns to seek revenge over the scientist.

Title: 347. Out of Order
description: Two former lovers, an embezzler, and a messenger boy become trapped on a Friday in a stalled office elevator.

description: An astronaut's widow and her young son meet a stranger from the future on a Greek island.

description: An American ambassador to Israel tries to bring peace to the Middle East conflict through unconventional methods, but his efforts are hampered at every turn and his personal life threatened.

description: Can a squad of misfit cheerleaders with an over-age trainer possibly win the big cheerleading competition? Looked down upon by the other teams, it will be difficult. Their lack of skill and talent make it even harder.

description: A hit-man tries to seduce the mother of a child who witnessed his most recent kill.

description: A large, claustrophobic apartment is the setting for this intense chamber drama. In this dense setting, the inhabitants of the apartment reveal their darkest secrets, fears, obsessions and hostilities.

description: Two retired thieves are blackmailed into teaching at a local Youth Probation Centre by ex-cop Chung. There, they teach the youngsters the value of self-respect. But their criminal past is never far behind.

description: Romance blossoms between two rival families practicing Shaolin and Wudang kungfu respectively. despite familial opposition - until they overcome a gang of scheming bandits together.

description: An American jewel thief in Monaco encounters various characters while trying to set up a robbery.

description: Young army officer of peasant origin becomes a war hero battling in the Sahara while seducing a young woman from the aristocratic class.

description: In search of her own identity, a young champion in fencing is torn between two men, which leads her to self-conflict.

They eventually tell their close friends Jérôme and Judith Martignac about the event. The Martignacs are both clerics, and Judith has just been giving a funeral service for a villager who committed suicide, though Jérôme would have nothing to do with suicide...

description: Kids start a fertilizer company only to see it almost destroyed by pesky adults. An inspirational story for enterprising children.

description: Three men attempt to seek vengeance against their oppressors.

description: Sickan has a new plan. This time, the gang will steal a small computer microchip that contains a top-secret plan of what the government intends to do with Sweden in the future. But Wall-Enberg is also planning to steal the chip. The payment will be 55 million Swedish crowns in gold and diamonds to whoever can deliver the chip to the foreign investors. Who will grab hold of the chip, the Jönsson gang or Wall-Enberg?

description: In Paris, a women's bag, which contains an embarrassing letter from the french president, is stolen.

Title: 374. Dangerous Moves
description: During the Cold War, the World Chess Championship clashed complete opposites - personal and political.

Title: 375. The Pirate
description: With the help of a couple of her oddball friends, a woman takes her former lesbian lover to a hotel to convince her that their affair shouldn't end. After much shouting and some sex, things complicate when the lover's husband shows up.

Title: 376. Kill the Referee
description: Michel,a referee has to suffer the consequences of having whistled a penalty against a team which is supported by football hooligans.

Title: 377. Future-Kill
description: The star of "The Texas Chainsaw Massacre" returns in a story about frat boys lost in the big city while hunted by a violent leader and his elite gang of gun-happy guards.

Title: 378. Loafing and Camouflage
description: The "adventures" of some friends during their military service.

Title: 379. Main Hoon Kunwari Dulhan
description: Watch the full movie, Main Hoon Kunwari Dulhan, only on Eros Now. Main Hoon Kunwari is a 2012 Indian Hindi film, directed by J. Neelam and produced by J. Neelam. The film stars Satnam Kaur, Durgesh Nandini, Anil Nagrath, Junior Jagdeep, , Munir Khan, Vinod Tripathi, K.K. Goswami, Brij Gopal in lead roles. The film had musical score by Nishad Vaidya.

Title: 380. The World of Don Camillo
description: A priest helps the small town he's stationed in to resolve conflicts by working together.

Title: 381. Vénus
description: Two American executives for a cosmetics company travel to the Greek islands in search for a model for their new line of suntan lotion, "Venus". They run into more than they bargained for.

Title: 382. Puri
description: A young, passionate woman struggles to keep her virtue in the midst of the temptations around her.

Title: 383. Disconnected
description: Alicia has started getting these very noisy, and disturbing phone calls. The question is, are they real, or is it all in her head?

Title: 384. A Cruel Romance
description: A bitter story about tender love and its cruel betrayal set in Russia of the 19th century.

description: In Stockholm, on St. Lucy's feast day, a bandit daringly robs a crowded post office. Within a fortnight, two witnesses are dead. Two cops from vice squad, Johansson and Jarnebring, who were the first to the crime scene, pursue all leads and identify a suspect, an arrogant member of the elite secret police, a man assigned to guard the country's Minister of Justice. Just as the beat cops think they've tightened the noose around the suspect, loose ends appear, witnesses lose their certainty, alibis crop up, and even the cops doubt what they've seen. Who's protecting the suspect and why?

description: A shy young man is irresistible to women.

description: Brazilian dealers battle Latino rivals in Manhattan using teen soldiers. Conflict grows to involve German supplier, his English girlfriend, Puerto Rican ex-cop, and Japanese captain amid corruption and violence.

Title: 390. Duniya
description: Framed for a crime he didn't commit, Mohan Kumar loses his wife, son, and freedom, then he emerges from prison vowing revenge.

Title: 391. Mashaal
description: A chain of events changes Vinod's life - from honest journalist to black marketer to an underworld Don and a Racketeer in order to combat Vardhan.

Title: 392. The Island Closest to Heaven
description: A high school girl travels to the island of New Caledonia and has magical adventures.

Title: 393. Badi
description: Unofficial Turkish remake of E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982)

Title: 394. Hell Riders
description: A woman whose car breaks down in the desert and attacked by bikers finds her way to a small town, where the town residents are terrorized by the psycho bikers.

Title: 395. Rope Torture
description: After an indiscretion with a younger man, her jealous husband disciplines poor Miki. He teaches her how to become the pig that she really is.

Title: 396. Annas Mutter
description: Based on the real case of Marianna Bachmeier from 1981, the film tells the story of a mother calmly and resolutely firing seven shots at the killer of her little daughter Anna in the courtroom.

Title: 397. An Amorous Woman of Tang Dynasty
description: A popular concubine becomes a Taoist priestess in order to avoid traditional roles designated to her as a woman by society, and focus on her studies and poetry. However, her trysts with both her maid and a ronin lead to trouble.

Title: 398. Evil Judgment
description: A desperate young woman, who witnessed her friend get killed, start her own investigation, aided by her boyfriend, after the police fail to catch a maniacal throat slasher.

Title: 400. Tu Solo
description: The daily life of those who dream of working in the world of the bullfighting. A movie that follows the pupils of the School of Tauromachy in Madrid. Reveals the human side of the bullfighter: his emotions, sensations, and sacrifices.

description: A teenager, wrongly convicted and sentenced to death for the murder of his father, escapes from jail. He hooks up with a prostitute and they take to the road to find the real killer of his father.
