Complications ensue when a sudden time warp occurs and both Sasuke and Kagero find themselves thrust hundreds of years into the future to Tokyo, Japan in 1984.

Title: 697. The Happy Ghost
description: A group of girls go on a camping trip and take shelter from the rain in an abandoned temple. One of them, Bonnie, takes a rope she found in the temple back with her not knowing that in the rope lies the soul of a fallen scholar from the Ching Dynasty. The ghost, Bindeye Pik, tries to help them with some of their daily trials and tribulations but then unwittingly gets them into trouble.

Title: 698. Dadayama
description: A woman plots her revenge after being duped by a slick, ruthless man who impregnates her and tries to bail out of marriage. Based on a true story.

Title: 699. Qaidi
description: Suraj lives in a small rural town in India with his widowed father, Yashpal, and a widowed sister, Sita. Suraj attends college, becomes a graduate and returns home to find that their family home is about to be auctioned at the behest of the cruel and influential Zamindar Bansilal, who refuses to allow them anymore time to re-pay his outstanding loan. The auction takes place, but is not enough to pay the loan, but Suraj assures them that he will do so when he gets a job in Bombay. Shortly thereafter, Yashpal kills himself; Sita is brutally raped and killed, and an enraged Suraj tries to kill Bansilal, Sharma, and Raghu, he does manage to kill Raghu and Sharma, but Bansilal escapes, and notifies the police, who locate, arrest Suraj, and have him sentenced to a long jail term. But Suraj escapes from prison and goes on the hunt for Bansilal. Before he could that he must first go through the police lines, who have cordoned off all routes to Bansilal, and have orders to shoot to kill Suraj on sight.

Title: 700. Baby
description: Baby is a young man who dreams of opening a gym. But he's gay and the man he loves is married and a criminal. Will Baby get involved/get caught/get his dreams fulfilled or destroyed?

Title: 701. Prea cald pentru luna mai
description: At a party, the head boy of the class seriously injures a passerby by throwing plates out the window. The accident brings under the magnifying glass the well-portrayed teenager, between shyness, frond and unconscious bravado.

Title: 702. Hip Hip Hurray
description: Sports is no for Jamnadas School in Ranchi so the boys out there pass their time by doing rebellious pastimes.Raghu is a smart looking boy on whom many girls have crush. But he is having a crush on a dusky school teacher.Sandeep Chaudhary an computer electronic engineer is waiting for a appointment letter from a big firm and mean while takes a job as a sports coach in the school he manages to make a good team with Raghu an others they being bad boys.Sandeep gets more closer to the dusky teacher where Raghu takes him as a rival in his love.

Title: 703. Chandrawal
description: Chandrawal is grand daughter of head of Gadia Lohar tribe, Jodha Sardar.

Title: 704. The Gold Medal
description: There are the good guys and the goons. The plot begins with the murder of an union leader, Acharya which leads to a gang whose members are identified by a gold medal with the gang's logo. Enter the head of Secret Services, David, a mysterious figure who weaves a web to bring the gang to book, including the mastermind. Gopal, a young officer is tasked with the job. To support him Dimple (David's niece) alias Shoba plays the girlfriend of Gopal and acts as a communication conduit. When Bindu a nightclub dancer is murdered and Gopal become the prime suspect Gopal joins the gang and earns the trust of the leader. Exploring the netherworld of drugs, stolen antiques, smuggling of gold and silver, creating social and religious tensions he learns the innermost secrets of the gang. Is Gopal a double agent, or has he found the lure of power, money and corruption irresistible? Has he turned triple? Will Shoba play along with Gopal's deceit? While some of the plot transitions leave the viewer baffled and edits incomprehensible, the overall story line is a product of its times, credible and entertaining.

Title: 706. The Executioner: Part II
description: An L.A. cop and a reporter team up to find a masked serial killer.

Title: 707. Die Story
description: A journalist from Munich brings revelations in a boulevard magazine about the trafficking in drugs in that city.

Title: 708. Pigs
description: Grim tale of marginalized souls in an apocalyptic Dublin inner city. Jimmy takes up residence in a derelict and once elegant house in a no-go inner area. He is soon joined by other squatters, George a business man trying to retain some dignity, Ronnie a drug dealer, Tom a paranoiac, Orwell a Jamaican pimp and his prostitute Mary

Title: 710. Wundkanal
description: Filbert , manipulated by his mentor Harlan, is a mass murderer who submits himself to police interrogation and Inquisition.

Title: 711. Pejzazi u magli
description: Naturalistic and almost documentary account of the heroin addicts in Belgrade, in the form of a sad life story of young girl and her wasted life.

Title: 712. Ake and His World
description: In 1929, the film follows the six-year old son of a Swedish country doctor. Åke lives with his parents and his sister Aja in a small provincial town. His best friend is Kalle Nubb. Åke is very frightened of the janitor Bergström as well as the lunatic Anne-Marie, his cousin who lives in the attic. There is also the strict principal Godeman as well as the religious cobbler Ebenholtz.

Title: 713. Camino solitario
description: Private detective Alfredo Pereira is hired by eccentric couple Raden and Eve to find their missing sister, Adriana. Despite his limitations, Pereira soon finds the woman, but foreplay between characters complicates things.

Title: 714. L'allenatore nel pallone
description: Trainer Oronzo Canà is called to manage Longobarda, the team of a small town of Northern Italy, when it's promoted to the First Division. His only task is not to go back to the Second Division, but even the team's owner plays against Longobarda since the First Division is too expensive, and the young Brazilian player bought for the team is affected by deep 'saudade'.

Title: 715. Pastoral Life
description: The inventive scoundrels from New Life, Thor and Danny, return in this sequel with a new bag of tricks. Here they present themselves as experts on agriculture and hoax an unfortunate farmer into trusting them with his animals while going abroad. Obviously, he shouldn't have.

Title: 716. Vediamoci chiaro
description: Alberto is a promising young man who plans to succeed with a new television programme, "We see it clearly". In an accident, he loses his sight, but he relies on the help of his good friend Gianluca to carry on with the programme.

Title: 717. Lily in Love
description: Aging Broadway star Fitz Wynn, upset his wife wrote a lead role for a younger man, disguises himself as a handsome young Italian to snag the part. His wife is unaware as he pursues the role he believes should be his.

Title: 718. The Children of the War
description: Based on the lives of four boys, all of different social classes and psychological makeup, this film tries to reflect through them the political history of Argentina during the years leading up to the Falklands War.

Title: 719. Prince Charming
description: Chen Li is the son of an enormously wealthy Hong Kong businessman and is vacationing in Hawaii, experiencing typical girl problems.

Title: 720. Run Chrissie Run!
description: Eve flees to Australia with daughter Chrissie when Riley, her ex-lover, resurfaces. Two IRA men hunting Riley for shooting their comrade join forces with a vengeful biker Eve wronged. All paths converge in Barossa Valley.

Title: 721. Kharag wa lam ya'ud
description: Escaping life in the big city of Cairo, to enjoy living in the countryside.

Title: 722. Últimas tardes con Teresa
description: A handsome hoodlum charms his way into the life of a pretty rich girl in 1950s Barcelona.

Title: 723. Final Mission
description: Vince Deacon, a higly decorated Vietnam War veteran, serves as a SWAT team captain for LAPD. When his family gets attacked by thugs and he kills one of them in self defense he's being suspended by his boss. Deacon and his family decide to spend the weekend camping at a lake to forget about everything but an explosion on their boat kills both his wife and kid. He finds out that Slater, a war buddy-turned-traitor is responsible for the murders. Deacon tracks him down to a small town in the mountains and gets his revenge only to be haunted by a redneck sheriff who happens to be Slater's brother. Not even his former commander, Col. Cain, or the National Guard can stop him now...

Title: 724. La smala
description: We are now in the suburbs of Lyon.Simone, a former rock singer is now working as domestic help.She deals specially with Robert, a former musician , who is unemployed and has five children.One day, Robert's wife left him to go to Paris with a cop.Robert is quite desperate and has decided to go to Paris to persuade his wife to come back.On the other side Simone has some days of vacation and she will travel to Paris to see her brother Pierrot.And surprise Simone and Robert and his family travel on same train.

Title: 725. Teppanyaki
description: Mr. Boo is seemingly doomed to spend the rest of his days as a cook in a teppanyaki restaurant, married to the corpulent and overbearing daughter of the gun-happy owner.

Title: 726. Jawaani
description: Sanam Malhotra's family becomes wealthy after selling land. When they oppose her romance with Karan, son of a bank manager, the couple elopes. After being rescued by Uncle Joe, Sanam discovers Karan has turned to smuggling.

Title: 727. Ölüm Savasçisi
description: Ninjas are on a murder spree, and the helpless police call for help from a Turkish police lieutenant who had once defeated them.

Title: 728. Street Hero
description: Vinnie is a teenage boy who is an outcast at school, alienating teachers and students alike and he is a courier for the local Mafia boss.

Title: 729. Mom I'm Paquito
description: Paquito lives with his mother in poverty. When she dies he looks for his father's love, who is a very wealthy man.

Title: 730. Atsay killer buti nga sa'yo
description: A Hot-Blooded Mature Man Is Held Hostage by Six Femme Fatales Who Just Broke out Of Jail.

Title: 731. Liberty at Night
description: In the midst of the Algerian events, a man finds happiness beside a local woman.

Title: 732. Maqsad
description: A wealthy industrialist is murdered and the blame falls on a person who hails from a poor family. To prove his innocence, he must strive hard to prove and gather evidence that clears him of this crime.

Title: 733. Claretta
description: A journalist wants to make a film about the life and death of Claretta Petacci, the mistress of Benito Mussolini. For this, she will turn to her sister Miriam.

Title: 734. Delta Space Mission
description: An advanced spaceship called Delta is created to establish dialogue between galactic civilizations. Soon after an alien journalist boards Delta, she and the captain realize the electronic brain that controls the ship has a will of its own.

Title: 735. Nallavanukku Nallavan
description: Gangadharan, a kind man reforms Manickam, a youngster and appoints him as in-charge in his factory. But Gangadharan becomes bankrupt and his son vows to avenge Manickam, believing that his father's business was swindled by Manickam.

Title: 736. Papirfuglen
description: The young Oslo lawyer Helen sees a man fall from a balcony, and realizes afterwards it's her father. Suicide or murder?

Title: 737. Hum Rahe Na Hum
description: Brij Mohan is married to the beautiful Kalyani, but is unhappy in his marriage: he doubts the sincerity of his wife's feelings.

Title: 738. The Miracle of Umitsubame Joe
description: In Okinawa, a Japanese-Filipino gangster named Joe kills an Okinawan mobster. Joe temporarily escapes the pursuing mob by fleeing to the Philippines, hoping to find there safety and perhaps to link up with his father. He meets Yoko, a saloon girl, who looks after him, but soon Joe's enemies show up, determined to make Joe pay.

Title: 739. Kita no hotaru
description: During the Meiji era, a brutal prison warden terrorizes convicts sentenced to forced labor to build the roads needed to open up the territory in the icy wilderness of Hokkaido.

Title: 740. Revenge of the Drunken Master
description: Accidentally discovering the operations of the Blood Ninja gangsters, a mischievous young man masters the skills of the Drunk Fist and proceeds to fight against them. But the gangsters join forces, vowing to kill him before the young master destroys them all.

Title: 741. Spiker
description: U.S. college athletes try out for the men's Olympic volleyball team under a tough coach (Michael Parks).

Title: 743. Prarthana
description: A tale of betrayal and redemption as brothers' rivalry escalates, unveiling dark desires and leading to familial rifts.

Title: 744. The End of War
description: As WW2 comes to an end in the former Yugoslavia, a man without an arm and his young son are on a mission. Their goal is to find and kill five members of the fascist militia who had tortured and killed their wife and mother.

Title: 745. Blood Boy Beasts ... Ready for Anything
description: The filmmaker Anton travels to Munich, where he and his friend Fietje want to make a film about the female bosom.

Title: 746. Best Revenge
description: An American tourist in Spain is forced to take part in a four million dollar drug deal, because his best friend has been kidnapped, and is being tortured by the drug kingpin who set up the operation.

Title: 747. Motel
description: The discovery of the mutilated body of a wealthy woman leads a detective to an isolated motel.

Title: 748. Trespasses
description: A puritanical widower is outraged when his daughter runs away to join a free-loving commune.

Title: 749. Viva la vie
description: The movie starts with an interview with director Claude Lelouch. He pleads viewers not to disclose the plot of the movie after leaving the projection room. Even the movie's trailer shows only a long sequence of faces gazing speechlessly in space. "Like all my movies, this one is about a man and a woman", says Lelouch in the interview.

Title: 750. Rive droite, rive gauche
description: Paul is a successful lawyer. Among others he represents is the investor Pervillard. In spite of being married Paul falls in love with a young lady named Sacha.

Title: 751. Interface
description: A group of strange beings at a master computer control room use their equipment to kill people by remote control.

Title: 752. Laila
description: Bitter hatred has always existed between two Rajput families, namely those of Bharat Singh and Prithviraj Singh, resulting in the death of Bharat's nephew. Years later, Prithviraj's son Dharamraj marries Sunaina, who gives birth to a baby boy named Deshraj. On Deshraj's 10th birthday, Prithviraj goes to make peace with Bharat and invites him for a birthday party, which Bharat attends, but there is no end to the animosity--which results in the death of Prithviraj when his chauffeur, Chandu, is bribed and manipulated by Bharat and his men. Beside himself with anger, Dharamraj poisons Chandu and sends Deshraj to the U.S. to live in a safer atmosphere as her continues his studies. Years later, Deshraj returns home and meets and falls in love with a young woman named Leela, who is none other than Chandu's daughter. Fearing for his son's life, Dharamraj proposes peace with Bharat and would like his son to marry Bharat's daughter Padmini. When Deshraj refuses to marry Padmini, Dharamraj is beside himself with anger and has Leela abducted and imprisoned. Deshraj must now make a choice: he can marry Padmini and ensure peace between the two families, or he can elope with Leela and live a life full of fear and uncertainty, not knowing when they will be killed, and whether it will be at the hands of Bharat or Dharamraj.

Title: 753. Taoism Drunkard
description: An incorrigible drunkard kung fu expert brings to this story all the rites and rituals of religion plus the foibles and cunning of the common men into one glorious long laugh.

Title: 754. Return of the Bastard Swordsman
description: Wudang is in trouble again, with both Dugu Wu Di planning to attack the Wudang temple and an interloping group of martial artists from Japan waiting in the background.

Title: 755. The Good Fight: The Abraham Lincoln Brigade in the Spanish Civil War
description: The story of an American Communist militia that fought for the Spanish Republicans in the 1936-39 Civil War.

Title: 756. Giochi d'estate
description: In Porto Rotondo there are stories of love and jealousy within a group of young people.

Title: 757. Billions for Boris
description: Three New York City kids fix a broken television and discover it now receives tomorrow's broadcast.

Title: 759. Louisiane
description: Virginia Tregan returns to her home in the U. S. Deep South from a sojourn in Paris only to discover that her family plantation and its holdings have been lost. She determines to recoup her family's fortune.

Title: 760. Un été d'enfer
description: Former motorcycle racer Philippe Darland, now assisting his uncle at a private detective agency, investigates the three-month disappearance of Valérie Leroy, a case that draws him into the drug underworld.

Title: 761. Pinot simple flic
description: Robert Pinot, a clumsy but honest Parisian police officer, meets then arrests Josyane, a young drug addict. He takes compassion for the girl and decides to take her under his wing to keep her away from Tony, a dangerous dealer she loves.

Title: 762. Amor Voraz
description: Ana is going through psychological problems. She and lifelong friend Cléia decide to revisit the place they spent their childhood together in an attempt to get better results in her treatment. But they meet a stranger who will upset their plans.

Title: 763. The Tale of Tsar Saltan
description: Czar marries one of three sisters and they have a son. The other two consumed by jealousy throw the girl and the boy into the sea. They end up on an island where the boy meets a magical swan who grants wishes. The boy uses three.

Title: 764. Three Stooges Go Undercover
description: Two police officers and an informant go undercover to infiltrate a counterfeiting ring.

Title: 765. Widziadlo
description: Piotr Strumienski (Roman Wilhelmi) is driven to the edge by haunting memories of his dead wife Angelika, and because of his obsession, his new wife Ola is driven to taking a lover - who mysteriously becomes paralyzed. Piotr keeps a special house on his property dedicated to Angelika, and he daydreams about making love to her there. His visions are so intense and real, that when he sees his son with a local, mute young woman, he shoots and wounds her because deluded, he thinks she is Angelika. After that tragedy, Piotr razes "Angelika's" house and it looks as though his fixation is healed, and everything should continue as normal - but that turns out to be a deception.

Title: 766. Damga
description: When a woman he loves is raped, Cengiz goes after those who did it.

Title: 767. Lovingly Yours, Helen (The Movie)
description: THIS DRAMATIC ANTHOLOGY OF TRUE-TO-LIFE STORIES OF LOVE AND DOMESTIC PROBLEMS BASED ON LETTERS SENT BY TV - DRAMA PROGRAM HOSTED BY HELEN VELA WHO GIVES ADVICE TO TROUBLED VIEWERS.

Title: 769. Sasural
description: Sasural is a 1984 Hindi movie produced by Biswanath Prasad Shahabadi and directed by Govind Moonis. The film stars Arun Govil, Bharat Bhushan, Arvind Deshpande, Gulshan Grover, Sadhana Singh and Dina Pathak.

Title: 770. Breakout
description: Two brothers take to Stockers Wood of a Saturday afternoon, to build a den and do some birdwatching. Their day takes a surprising turn when a car is dumped in the woods. Curious, David investigates the boot of the car. What he finds is a suitcase of clothes and identification. Soon afterwards, the men on the identification appear to pick up the car, and discover the two boys have been spying on them. The two men are prison escapees, who are keen to get away and beat the police roadblocks. They decide to use the boys to convey the impression they are all related and go through the roadblocks. Be prepared for a charming 80's TV film that will warm your heart.

Title: 771. Among the Cinders
description: Teen Nick is estranged from his family, and blaming himself for his Maori mate's climbing death. He runs away to his straight talking grandfather - who takes him bush - and loses his virginity to Sally.

Title: 772. Akkare
description: Gopi is having a moderate but highly respected life as a Tehsildar(regional land and tax officer) but his wife wants more.

Title: 773. Merton
description: Merton was hailed as a prophet and censured for his outspoken social criticism. For nearly 27 years he was a monk of the Trappist order, where he became a spiritual writer, as well as an anti-war advocate and witness for peace.

Title: 775. Mesrine
description: Paris, May 1978. Dangerous crook Jacques Mesrine manages to escape from prison. His escape companions are François Besse and another accomplice, who is shot dead during their escape.

Title: 776. Where's Picone?
description: During a debate in Naples' town hall in the early 1980s, Pasquale Picone, a former steel-worker who has recently lost his job, sets himself on fire in front of the Municipal Council.

Title: 777. First Strike
description: A U.S. Navy submarine captain tries to prevent the Soviets from trying to launch World War III.

Title: 778. Silent Romance
description: Dumb Boy, a deaf and dumb, yet a brilliant cartoonist whose current publication has been ignored by his readers. When Cactus, a night club hostess, walks into his life, he silently and secretly falls in love with her.

Title: 779. El jardín secreto
description: Lucia is a computer expert who relieves stress through secret nightly s&m sessions, where she plays the sub. One day, a letter from her supposedly dead ex lover arrives, so she and her new partner investigate the matter.

Title: 780. Tasio
description: The childhood, love adventures, and ordinary life of Tasio, a coal maker in rural Navarre.

Title: 781. Blood Suckers from Outer Space
description: Farmers in Texas become brainwashed bloodsuckers.

Title: 783. Im Himmel ist die Hölle los
description: Teenage girl idolises television game show host, and gets a chance to be his assistant

Title: 784. As Not to Fly the Smoke
description: Fahmy Abdel-Hadi is an outstanding rural student at the Faculty of Law. His dreams are simple and his dealings are dominated by idealism and purity. He collides with the bitter reality when he loses his mother in search of the price of her treatment while he sees his colleagues and those around him spending lavishly and mocking his poverty and even refusing to help him to treat his mother while he works to serve them. He decides to abandon idealism and take revenge on all those who failed him while he was poor.

Title: 785. In Heaven There Is No Beer?
description: A portrait of the life, culture and food surrounding the lovers of Polka music. The title is taken from an old Polka standard. Stars of the Polka world are highlighted.

Title: 786. Femmes de personne
description: Cécile, a single mother, contrives to meet Gilquin, the married father of a classmate of her nearly-adolescent son. An affair ensues. Isabelle, approaching middle age with two children, discovers she's pregnant, goes into a funk, and arranges for a younger woman to seduce her husband. Adeline is distraught at her ex-lover's plan to leave France. The three women are colleagues at a radiology clinic. They come to each other's aid, but each must decide on her own what course to take: Cécile with Gilquin, Isabelle with her husband, and Adeline with her solitude.

Title: 787. The Deserted City
description: After reading a newspaper article about a town being destroyed in a fire, Eguchi begins to recall the summer he spent there writing his thesis. It's a beautiful canal town, the "Venice of Japan." As he arrives, he is greeted by the daughter of the Kaibara household, Yasuko. The rest of her family seems mysteriously absent. On his first night, Eguchi hears the stifled sound of crying. He attempts to find the source, and is soon drawn into the conflict that is tearing the family apart. While he likens the town to a dream, some of the inhabitants do not share his feelings. There is a sense of being stuck in time, with ruin and death the only future.

Title: 788. The Slavers
description: A man searches for a missing woman who has been kidnapped by a deranged Professor with sinister intentions.

Title: 789. Kanoon Kya Karega
description: Advocate Gautam Mehra lives in Bombay with his wife, Anju, and a daughter, Rakhsa. One day while returning from court he sees a woman being molested. He stops, phones the police, and then tries to stop the molester, in vain, though as himself gets attacked and loses consciousness. But the police do arrive and arrest the molester. Raghuvir's attempts to convince Gautam to change his testimony are in vain. Gautam goes on to testify against Raghuvir Singh, and gets him sentenced to seven years rigorous prison. Six years later, Raghuvir re-enters the lives of the Mehras, and he is not going to disappear until he has had his vengeance against all three. Efforts to stop him through the police are in vain, as he has not committed any crime yet. The Mehras decide to re-locate to their farm house near a lake without notifying anyone. While they are being re-located Gautam finds out that it is not just Raghuvir who is out for vengeance - there is someone other than him who wants them dead.

Title: 790. Unfinished Business
description: Seventeen year old Isabelle Marks lives in Toronto with her divorced mother and finds her life directionless. Isabelle becomes involved with an anti-nuclear group that her boyfriend Jessie 'Fixit' is connected with and is arrested at a demonstration.

Title: 791. Paar
description: This is Goutam Ghose's speculative commentary on poverty and exploitation in rural Bihar, based on Bengali story Paathi.

Title: 792. The Big Tease: Here Comes Another One
description: Candid camera with an alien spaceship in Tel Aviv, a Mohel with a butcher's knife, a speaking ATM and a shaving cream cake. Topping it off, a pedestrian is fooled into exposing her huge breasts and later having them exploited.

Title: 793. Pituitary Hunter
description: A gang of unhappily subtitled detectives follow a trail of pilfered pituitary glands across Hong Kong, uncovering a coterie of black market habitues with equally desperate claims to illicitly harvested human growth hormones.

Title: 794. Darling, Let's Get Naked!
description: During a sun-kissed summer in Greece, a skirt-chasing local preaches freedom for all—provided they aren't our sisters—until a charming Athenian tourist shatters his double standards by falling for the only unavailable woman on the island.

Title: 795. Bava Maradallu
description: Bava Maradallu is a 1994 Indian Telugu film, directed by A Kodandarami Reddy and produced by M Narasimha Rao. The film StarsRajinikanth, Ambhika, Radha, and Cass Mass in lead roles. The music of the film was composed by Chakravarthy.

Title: 796. The Snowdrop Festivities
description: This movie is based on texts of Bohumil Hrabal, world-known Czech prosaic. It's a story (in a form of a mosaic of short episodes and pictures) about the sadness and happiness of inhabitants of Kersko (Kersko is a small woody area full of cottages and roods). These people are both simple and sensitive, they have their own pleasures (e.g. Leli is a collector of cheap, but inutile things) and the greatest delight of all of them is a hunting. Crude poetics of amateur hunting is screened by dreamy pictures of this area. Menzel mixes sentimental lyricism and rough (but not vulgar!) humor and the outcome is the never-ending landscape of continuous life in the proximate nearness of nature. The performances of actors are brilliant. Both Rudolf Hrusinsky as a Franz and Jaromír Hanzlik as a Leli have nonrecurring charm bottomed on a pain and inebriation. Only the music is not perfect: Jiri Sust usually assembled his film music from his older works and in this movie there is many quotations.

Title: 797. Uno scugnizzo a New York
description: The story of Nino, a street boy from Naples, and his friend Matumba, a boy from New York who wants to emigrate to Naples.

Title: 798. Haunters of the Deep
description: An American brings his daughter from the bright lights of the USA to the mystical landscapes of Cornwall, with the intention of reviving the tin mining tradition. But the ghosts of the mines have other ideas.

Title: 799. I kathodos ton 9
description: Near the end of the Greek Civil War the last DSE rebels of the Taygetus mountain range try to reach the sea alive.

Title: 800. Popcorn und Paprika
description: The German national swim team is on their way to an international contest against Hungary. A busload of young kids is looking forward to a week of fun in the "Paris of the East". But when top swimmer Peter falls in love with a Hungarian girl, Sigi, the coach knows that he's heading for trouble.

Title: 801. A Man Called Rage
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a soldier of fortune enters "The Forbidden Land" to find uranium that will help save mankind. However, a rival adventurer is also after the uranium, but for his own ends.

Title: 802. Crónica dos Bons Malandros
description: Living in expeditions, a gang of friendly Malandro Lisboetas is one day contacted by mysterious Italian (from the Mafia, it is assumed) to steal part of the Lalique Collection, at the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation Museum.

Title: 803. Bajing Ireng dan Jaka Sembung
description: Balung Wesi was defeated in battle and is seeking revenge on Ki Sapu Angin, the teacher of Jaka Sembung, The Warrior. In mobilizing power to fight the Dutch, The Warrior makes the acquaintance of Bajing Ireng (Black Ninja).

Title: 804. The Shanghai Thirteen
description: A patriot finds evidence that the government is collaborating with a foreign power. He gets assistance from a local rebel leader who is in charge of a motley group of fighters called the Shanghai 13.

Title: 805. Space Riders
description: Roger Gilbert is an adrenaline junkie who leads an otherwise ordinary life until one day he rides where no man had ridden before. On his ride to the planet Stardust 420, he meets an Aupian named Flou-krepto.

Title: 806. Neengal Kettavai
description: Poornima, a widow living in Ooty leads a peaceful life with her two sons. Jaishankar, a tourist who visits the place gets tempted and rapes her. In the act, Poornima dies leaving her two sons who witness the murder. With a turn of events leading to both sons joining together and take revenge for their mother's death forms the rest of the story.

Title: 807. Devanthakudu
description: Vijay (chiranjeevi) has a habit of accepting challenges; his friend Chanti throws a challenge at him to kill a professor. The challenge turns ugly when the professor is killed for real and the blame falls on Vijay.

Title: 808. Woman Who Wets Her Fingers
description: Real-Life stripper Madoka Mika plays the fictional ROSE RED, a former striptease queen who is now doing roadshow engagements while trying to raise her kid and balance her love affairs.

Title: 809. Kizlar Sinifi
description: The new teacher in the class is belittled by the students.

Title: 810. Teri Baahon Mein
description: Teri bahon mein amar saroj

Title: 812. Todo o nada
description: A street vendor and an unemployed begin to work in a drug trafficking company.

Title: 813. Chain Gang
description: Mac McPherson is framed for murder and sentenced to prison at the Black Creek Prison Farm. He must escape to prove his innocence and find the real killer.

Title: 814. Mga batang yagit
description: Four children find one another after Elisa and her mother are thrown out of the house by the evil mother-in-law. Left to fend for themselves, they end up living with their mother's bar-girl friend in an informal settlement.

Title: 815. Sonatine
description: Two teenaged friends have separate difficult experiences that make the girls seriously consider suicide.

Title: 816. Dvazhdy rozhdyonnyy
description: World War 2, White Sea. A Soviet transport ship carrying wounded from the front line is sunk by German planes. The ship's only survivor, an 18-year old conscript is being pursued from the air by the German ace pilot who wants to "finish the job".

Title: 817. Chto u Senki bylo
description: Home alone because his father took his pregnant mother to the hospital, five-year-old Senka has an amazing adventure in the village.

Title: 818. Atalia
description: Atalia is a 40-year-old widow who lost her husband in the Six-Day War and lives on a kibbutz with her adolescent daughter. Lonely and feeling outcast, she enters into a forbidden affair with her daughter's classmate, Matti, an idealistic 19-year-old rejected by the army.

Title: 819. The Occupant
description: Angie goes to Hong Kong to work on a Master's thesis focusing on the Chinese superstition. She rents a spacious apartment, without knowing it's haunted by the ghost of a singer.

Title: 820. Thrillkill
description: Karlie Kendall's job is to write computer games - but in her spare time she hacks bank accounts. With 5 million dollars gathered, she wants to retire to Brazil - unaware that her secret partner Adrienne intends to keep all the money.

Title: 821. Zware jongens
description: Gaston grew up on the edge of society and avoids people. Leo is a good man living beyond his means. Fate drives them together.

Title: 822. Rage and Glory
description: An avowed anarchist and Stern Gang hitman is sent to Jerusalem to assassinate a senior British officer creating much tension within the already troubled cell and almost brings its collapse, as the British operatives are closing in. Heralded by the Film Society of Lincoln Center as one of the most important films in fifty years of Israeli cinema.

Title: 823. The Adventures of Pinocchio
description: A puppet goes on a fantastical adventure in a quest to turn into a real boy.

Title: 824. Lars i porten
description: The summer Lars turned 12, he still feels he should stay away from the girls, but the prostitute Lill teaches him to dance tango. He also have an uncle with a motorbike.

Title: 825. Snake Sisters
description: Three snake sisters try to lure men.

Title: 826. Desiderio
description: In an Italian hotel where a first communion party is in full swing, Vincenzo unexpectedly enters Lucia's room. A half-consented rape ensues. Lucia ends up enjoying the amorous assault of the brutish but attractive man just before rebelling, knocking him out and running away. On the road, she runs into the first communion girl, but Vincenzo finds them and pursues them.

Title: 827. Ehtares min Alkhot
description: Khousosi works for his late uncle's company and he's mad in love with his cousin Bolbola and wishes to marry her, but her mother is against it because she believes he's after the family's fortune. Feeling depressed, he seeks the help of Sami, the company's secretary who arranges for him to meet a hired killer in order to finish him off and cause Bolbola to regret her mistreatment towards him. Khousosi doesn't know that Sami intends to marry Bolbola as well, and also has plans to take over the company with the help of a cheating contractor. Later, Khousosi finds an old man in his apartment who turns out to be the killer but he doesn't murder him, and instead he suggests that he must fake his death to see how people are going to react to the news of his suicide. On the following day, Bolbola reads about her cousin's death in the newspaper, and that is when Sami tells her that he has embezzled lots of money from her company. It is up to Khousosi to prove his innocence to the world and to the woman he loves with the help of the killer and some of his felon friends just to teach Sami a lesson.

Title: 828. Blame It on the Night
description: When his unmarried mother dies, custody of 13-year-old Job is assumed by his alleged father, Chris, whom he has never seen. Job is an enthusiastic cadet at a military academy, and Chris turns out to be a top-grossing rock star who removes Job from his beloved school to keep him company on tour. Getting acquainted is fraught with culture shock for both father and son.

Title: 829. Bacanais na Ilha das Ninfetas
description: It's the story of romantic singer Dick Boy, who finds a treasure on an island with the help of five horny girls, the nymphets from the title. They have their pubic hair in the shape of a heart, each one with a different color. Isn't is cute? Of course problems arise when ambition turn the girls against each other.

Title: 830. May lamok sa loob ng kulambo
description: Lauro (Eddie Garcia) is a married man who just loves women. His wife Elena (Gloria Diaz), a beautiful and strong-willed woman, is dead-set on keeping him from womanizing.

Title: 831. Sariwa
description: A barrio lass.who tries to seek good fortune in the city ends up abused by men who promise to help her realized her simple dreams.

Title: 832. Door to Door
description: This TV-oriented story is about a smooth-talking salesman who peddles vacuum cleaners but is really a con man out to get money. The con artist/salesman Larry (Ron Leibman) meets Leon (Arliss Howard), an honest salesman who is making no money at all, and teaches him how to swindle his way to riches. The two team up, taking in everyone from car dealers to a poor widow, whose niece Katherine (Jane Kaczmarek) has sparked the interest of Leon. But since Larry himself is being blackmailed by a detective for the vacuum-cleaner company, his ultimate concern is getting rid of this drain on his hardly-earned money. ~ Eleanor Mannikka, All Movie G uide

Title: 833. Run Tiger, Run
description: Two street urchins meet up with a sad and lonely rich kid. They become friends when the kid's shady uncle mistakes them for his nephews.

Title: 834. Slash
description: Wall to wall action. Roy Kristoff and Michael Monty team up together in this highflying action-war thriller, to save the country form a communist uprising. filled with explosive-excitement in every scene. The war was supposed to be over, but the battle to survive has only just begun. A film not to be missed.

Title: 835. Anak ni Waray vs anak ni Biday
description: Snooky and Maricel play the daughters of Ilocano Manang Biday and Visayn Inday Waray, characters made famous by 1950s movie queens Gloria Romero and Nida Blanca.

Title: 836. Adam et Ève
description: Movie producer Léon Blachurpe is about to produce a big budget movie about Adam and Eve. In order to get the money, he agrees to hire ex movie star La Maldiva to play the lead part, but she's old and ugly, so the scenes are actually shot with the stunt woman !

Title: 837. Holi
description: In a typical college in a typical Indian city, the hostel boys Madan Sharma (Aamir Khan) and his friend are a rowdy lot. The teaching staff suffer from the common apathy of most teachers in similar colleges. The administration has the usual problems, with ill-paid employees periodically going on strike. On the whole, the college is a very normal place. But on this particular day, when Madan and his friends rise from their slumber, some with the customary hangover, they are not so perturbed to find no water in the taps again, as when they hear that it is not going to be a holiday after all. Instead there will be a lecture in the auditorium by the Chairman of the Board (Dr. Shriram Lagoo), on the day of the festival of fire, Holi, and the boys decide not to attend the classes. The hostel superintendent Professor Singh (Naseeruddin Shah), the only lecturer with some human links with the students, watches with apprehension their growing restlessness. A notice announcing a further postponement of examinations adds to the bitterness. A fight erupts out of nowhere between principal Phande's (Om Puri) nephew and another student, in which the principal's nephew is hurt and the other boy is promptly rusticated. It is an unjustifiably drastic punishment, and the news spreads like wildfire. Resistance is organized in the library, in the laboratory, in the classrooms and the college grounds. In the auditorium, the first egg hits the Chairman, and pandemonium follows. To save his own job, the principal decides to track down the culprits. Professor Singh politely refuses to help. The principal now blackmails one of the hostel boys, whose father he knows, and who is in any case a loner, and a butt of jokes in the campus. Imbued with a false sense of power, the boy walks into the principal's trap. A large group of boys, all from the hostel, are immediately rusticated, and asked to vacate their rooms by the morning. The boys, not all of them actually guilty of rebellion, are now all in a rage. They make a bonfire of the hostel furniture and their textbooks. Feeling impelled to share his sense of triumph, the informer confides in the boy whom he hates and fears the most, and whose name he has kept out of the list. As a result he is mercilessly humiliated by everyone, and just about manages to rush away from his tormentors and lock himself in his room. In the gathering dusk, the young rebels sit listlessly on the steps of the hostel, their anger giving way to depression, when one of them discovers the informer hanging from the fan in his room, quite dead. Madan and his friends confront faceless policemen who come to investigate the suicide. In the morning, the police van carrying the boys away, is caught in the midst of a rowdy, jostling crowd of merrymakers, playing with colours. Madan and his friends stare blankly, hopelessly, out of the barred windows at the shouting revelers, as the van edges its way out.

Title: 838. Le joli coeur
description: Frank and Bernard share the same apartment .Frank is a womanizer ,but his friend is shy and asks for his help to find a wife.

Title: 839. The Little Prince
description: A pilot falls with his airplane in the desert and finds a blond and fragile child there. She says she came from a small distant planet. And there, in living with the lost pilot, both rethink their values and find the meaning of life.

Title: 840. The Last Kamikaze
description: A cruel contract killer nicknamed "Kamikaze" uses all kinds of methods to carry out his work. One day he will have to face an old enemy who has an old score to settle with him.

Title: 841. Crever à 20 ans
description: Two unemployed young people cannot carry out their projects for lack of money. They both need friendship and love. They decide to prostitute themselves. Unfortunately, what appeared to be an easy solution quickly becomes a dead end.

Title: 842. El-Nemr El-Aswad
description: Mohamed travels to Germany to work and faces language barriers and racism. He meets Helga, a German who speaks some Arabic and helps him learn the language, and a Greek boxing coach, Costa, who supports him until he becomes a champion.

Title: 843. I'm Almost Not Crazy: John Cassavetes - the Man and His Work
description: Director Michael Ventura goes behind the scenes on the set of John Cassavetes' last written and directed movie, Love Streams (1984).

Title: 844. Zhi zhuan yi jian
description: A rampaging swordsman slices and dices his way across China on a bloody mission to cut down every warrior in his way, and claim the blade of the legendary Supreme Swordsman in this Shaw Brothers classic starring Derek Yee and Jason Pai Piao, and directed by Keith Li Baak Ling. But when the son of a slain sword maker emerges as an unexpected challenger, the ruthless killer realizes that he may have finally met his match.

Title: 845. Vaidehi Kaathirundaal
description: A homeless man and a young widow develop an affectionate bond for each other due to similarly tragic past. They then take it upon themselves to save a young couple in love from the wrath of the villagers.

Title: 847. Un poeta nel Cinema: Andreij Tarkovskij
description: Tarkovsky expounds on his life and work, the essential importance of fighting, the conceptual nonexistence of happiness, what childhood determines about us, wartime's impact on fantasies, and the salutary effects of a year laboring in Siberia.

Title: 848. In 'n Out
description: A comical story of a scatter brained hero who is invited to his Pa's funeral. Never having known his father but still suspecting foul play, he travels to Mexico to learn the truth with hilarious results.

Title: 849. Accessories
description: Anatoly wandered through prisons since his youth and, after serving nine years, decided to make a confession to investigator Khlebnikov that ten years ago, in a company with other teenagers, he committed murder during a fight. But over the years, people's fates have diverged, and all members of the street company have become normal members of society. The law requires punishment, but won't it break the possible future of these people and their families? When Anatoly was released from prison, he met with Khlebnikov, experiencing a natural craving for a person who humanly showed a participation in his fate, and most importantly - believed. Yesterday's prisoner, who had no experience of his adult free life, had to adapt to life in freedom. But not everything turned out to be within the power of Anatoly, and the investigator again and again helped his ward out of trouble so that he did not return to the zone .

Title: 850. The Settlement
description: Down-on-their-luck drifters Kearney and Martin wander into the small town of Cedar Creek looking to swindle a few pounds from the locals. After a not-too-friendly reception, the pair decide to move into an abandoned shack on the outskirts of town. They are soon joined in their new home by Joycie, another town outcast with a shady past. While the three manage to start a rather happy life together, they soon find that others in the town strongly disapprove of their living arrangements.

Title: 851. Nokketha Dhoorathu Kannum Nattu
description: A young girl on an unannounced visit changes the lives of her lonely grandmother and several other people in the neighbourhood by her joie de vivre.

Title: 852. Revenge of the Ninja
description: After a mystically powered red necklace is stolen from a man by a crime gang, a battle between good and evil spirits erupts in powerful ways.

Title: 853. Erscheinen Pflicht
description: The 16-year-old upper school student Elisabeth has grown up as a well-protected daughter of an established comrade and council chairman. By the sudden death of the father, she is torn from her privileged, even rhythm of life. Elisabeth sees herself exposed to truths that make her look at the image of the father who is a role model for her in a more differentiated way. Because not all judge their father as positively as they do. So she deals with a critical school friend and with her depressed mother; she also makes contact with her brother, who long ago distanced herself from the parents' home. Elisabeth pursues the contradictions and finally finds a new self-concept.

Title: 854. Music of the Spheres
description: Set in the not-too-distant future, when the existing world economy has collapsed, and the new city-states are controlled by computers, many of which require a kind of telepathic linkage with a human counterpart. When the most important of these computers exhibits strange patterns during a crucial operation, its counterpart, a top scientist named Melody, begins having psychic experiences. For a low-budget film, a surprisingly deep exploration of emotions vs. logic and the elusive search for truth.

Title: 855. Un ragazzo e una ragazza
description: Anna De Rosa is a Neapolitan girl who goes to Milan to attend university.Calogero Bertolotti is a young Milanese who studies psychology. They meet at a bar and it's love at first sight.

Title: 856. The Dream Chasers
description: Two unlikely companions face gun-slinging cowboys and their own personal family conflicts as they learn the importance of friendship, loyalty, and forgiveness.

Title: 858. S.O.S. Sex-Shop
description: After seven years, Cláudio and Elisa's marriage is in danger. Some friends take Cláudio to a sex-shop, where he buys a rubber tongue, a little device that can save their relationship.

Title: 859. Office Ladies: Lesbians in Uniforms 3
description: Two young women, Minako and Naomi, have been friends and lovers since their school days, and are now living as roommates in the city, working together for a large company. Although she cares for Minako, Naomi decides that she should leave behind her past, find a husband and have kids. Minako, on the other hand, is happy with things as they are and doesn't want to change. The two must work out what they really want out of life, going their separate ways if need be.

Title: 860. Shree Krishnaparanthu
description: A gifted youth inherits sorcery duties after his ancestor's death. With ancestral spirits and deity support, he gains immense power. After losing his abilities, he fights to survive against demons and dark magic.

Title: 861. High Noon Ripper
description: A journalist. Two photographers. One infamous serial killer on the loose. DARKROOM FANTASIES is directed by Academy Award Winning Director Yojiro Takita.

Title: 863. The Devil Has the Biggest Tits You Ever Saw
864. A Proper Scandal
description: The real story takes of Bruneri/Canella case (Italy 1926). A man is hospitalized in a neurological clinic suffering from amnesia. Mrs Ballerini, after had seen his picture complains he is her husband and brings him her home. They start living a regular life, even if the man still couldn't remember his past. When also Mrs Polacich recognizes him as her husband a process is set up. Italian audience is literally shared in two parties supporting one or the other family. Mrs. Ballerini will succeed anyway to come back together with her presumed husband and escape with him to Brazil. Years later also the Vatican will recognize their two children as 'legally conceived' under catholic laws.

Title: 865. Heroes for Hire
description: Miami 1980, a doctor transplants a metal object into a patients arm. He tells him to go home and relax, but soon the patient kills the doctor. One year later, Prof. Arlington is kidnapped by thugs and taken to a secret location. Awesome action ensues.

Title: 866. Renzoku jûgo-nin hanayome okashi
description: 15 women returning from a meeting see a pregnant woman being raped by three men. The woman loses her unborn infant and commits suicide. Her fiance finds out their identity and plots vengeance.

Title: 867. Kamalolmolk
description: The movie chronicles the life of the famous painter Kamololmolk, and his relationship with various kings.

Title: 868. Morgen in Alabama
description: After assaulting a minister, a young defendant claims to have acted entirely by himself. His lawyer doesn't believe him and starts investigations of his own.

Title: 869. Wu seng
description: A troop of monks from the Shaolin Temple embark on a mission to get the Golden Sutra to Tibet after the Shaolin Abbot is killed by their traitorous teacher. They are joined on their quest by a beautiful, female warrior - with aims to avenge her father's death. They traverse forests and mountains on their mission, all the while fighting off deadly ninja assassins, vicious gangsters and even the undead.

Title: 870. The Naked Sun
description: A love story about an honest businessman in dire straits.

Title: 872. Ab Ayega Mazaa
description: Vijay and Nupur start liking each other after a chance meeting at a bus stop. Suresh (Sidey) is Vijay's boss' son and wants to marry Nupur but ends up liking Nupur's maid, Imarti. Sidey's father is under the influence of a pot-smoking Swami who has a terrible secret hidden from everyone.

Title: 873. In Search of a Golden Sky
description: Three children escape into the wilderness to avoid being placed in an orphanage.

Title: 874. Mad Warrior
description: World War III is over, the planet is mostly uninhabitable. On an island in the Pacific, the Islanders survive this cursed world in a fortified colony. Under the orders of the maniacal Zeus they are forced to fight each other to the death.

Title: 875. USA sex girl: Chikan kinpatsu densha
876. Sri Madvirat Veera Brahmendra Swamy Charitra
description: The story of this film is based on the life of a well known saint and astrologer Pothuluru Veerabrahmendra Swamy.

Title: 879. Poochakkoru Mookkuthi
description: The misunderstanding caused due to two women having the same name escalate wildly out of control for everyone involved.

Title: 880. Akalmand
description: Tamil-speaking Priya and Punjabi-speaking Dr. Kiran meet and fall in love and get married. Kiran likes to drink and likes the company of women; Priya is aware of this and always suspects him of having an affair. When Shobha decides to go to her parents' house, Kiran meets with dancer/singer, Lulu, spends the night with her, and wakes up the next morning to find her dead body. Fearing that the Police will arrest him and his wife will leave him, he throws the body off a bridge into a river and returns home to try to lead a normal life. When the Police find Lulu's body, they discover that she had taken a taxi to Kiran's house on the night of her death. It looks like Kiran must face the consequences of being arrested and his wife leaving him.

Title: 881. Kamiondzije opet voze
description: In the sequel to "Truckers," truck driver Jare builds a new house for his large family. Since he's the only one who works for all of them, he sets himself an impossible mission to pay off all of his loans with help from his best friend and associate Paja. So begins the never-ending sequence of bad luck they must face.

Title: 882. Odaruthammava Aalariyam
description: A flirtatious old man starts a wager with three flirtatious young men that they should make his daughter fall for any one of them.

Title: 883. Girgiriye'de Büyük Seçim
description: All Sulukule residents gathered and gave their support to their candidates for the election of a new ceremonial leader. For this task, which was passed from father to son in the past, a general election was held by keeping up with the modern age.

Title: 884. Students
description: A romance between a student of a college of high class and a cadet of the nearby Naval Academy.

Title: 885. Kaya kong abutin ang langit
description: A highly ambitious goddaughter abuses all her relationships to reach high society, crushing her integrity as she tries to quench her thirst for power and influence.

Title: 886. Yaadgaar
description: After the passing of his father, an unemployed slacker-trouble-maker faces many challenges and humiliation when he goes to live with his married sister and her family.

Title: 887. Sta se zgodi kad se ljubav rodi
description: Misha in the music school falls in love with a young Russian girl Natasha, which was then located in Belgrade. But their parents think that they are too young for love forgetting about his crazy year. Natasha's parents do not allow that connection, so go back to Moscow. Unlike parents who want to end their relationship Zika and Milan are on their side. Zika begins to learn the Russian language.

Title: 888. Paapi Pet Ka Sawaal Hai
description: A robin hood kind of story

Title: 889. Amor Maldito
description: Two young women with different social backgrounds have a lesbian relationship. The real problems begin when one of them also gets involved with a man, a journalist.

Title: 890. Aalkkoottathil Thaniye
description: The impending death of an ailing schoolteacher forces a set of uncomfortable reunions between mourners.

Title: 891. Dhavani Kannavukal
description: An unemployed gold medalist tries to become rich for his big family.

Title: 892. Burning Angel
description: A newly graduated nurse Tuulikki starts a job in a closed ward of a psychiatric hospital. Her innocence is being challenged by both her colleagues and patients. A new patient Katariina has a fire burning deep inside of her.

Title: 893. Hookers on Davie
description: Filmmakers Holly Dale and Janis Cole explore the culture of Davie Street, located in the underbelly of Vancouver, where dozens of prostitutes work and live every day. Surprisingly, they find that the sex trade there is stable and largely non-violent, and that the women who work on Davie Street meet daily to discuss safety and health issues and don't use pimps. The film also includes candid interviews with the prostitutes and footage of negotiations with potential clients.

Title: 894. Nudo e crudele
description: Explores bizarre customs and disturbing practices across different cultures, from illegal activities in Hong Kong to extreme tribal rituals in Africa and unusual eating habits in Asia.

Title: 895. ¿Cuánto cobra un espía?
description: A struggling composer named Juan and his bride Ana become targets of spies while on their honeymoon. The spies want to get their hands on Juan's latest score "Butterfly 2" as they believe that it contains a valuable secret formula.

Title: 896. Lentävät luupäät
description: Two guys from Häme find out that they actually are from Karjala. At the same time Flybug bites one of the guys. That means he must learn to fly or he gonna die. Reborn Karjala-boys goes at the airport and fun begins. Soon they become acquainted with a robot that runs with booze, two scoundrels and beautiful Miss Universum.

Title: 897. The Killing Edge
description: In a post-nuclear-war wasteland, a man searches for his family while trying to avoid deadly killer robots.

Title: 898. Divorce
description: Rich businessman Oswal forces his elder son to marry his choice instead of his love. His younger son elopes with Seema. After seeing her with another man, he divorces her and joins the army. Family faces mounting troubles.

Title: 899. Les Brésiliennes du Bois de Boulogne
900. The Shakers: Hands to Work, Hearts to God
description: Ken Burns examines the American utopian 19th century religious sect known as the Shakers.

Title: 901. Uramisten
description: Young artiste (Oszkár Sajek) has an accident and gets a limp. He finds out that a superannuated artiste (Lipót Binder) has a fantastic attraction. Sajek would do anything to get it, but Lipót Binder is a very stubborn old man.

Title: 902. Khandhar
description: Subhash is a photographer from the city, who has come to take pictures of some old temples and ruins in a village. Ruins fascinate him. While in the village, he gets acquainted with a young woman, Jamini, who has had her heart broken in the past, by another visitor from the big city. Will history repeat itself, or will she find a way out of the ruins at last?

Title: 903. Love in a Fallen City
description: A cynical playboy pursues an introverted divorcee in the decadence of Hong Kong on the eve of the 1941 Japanese invasion.

Title: 904. Jhutha Sach
description: After the passing away of his wife (Sunita), Vijay brings up his two children, Bhishan and Charudatta, who want him to re-marry, and go around selecting a mother. They pick on Alka, who is a stage singer, and lives alone as a paying guest. Vijay and Alka approve of each other, get married, and go for a honey-moon. On the way back Vijay drives too fast, has an accident, and is killed. Alka does not have the courage to tell the children, so she hires Vijay's look-alike, a dreaded bandit and killer, Tiger, who agrees to impersonate Vijay for 30 days, make the kids hate him, then leave forever - for a sum of 3 Lakh rupees. Things do go according to plan, and the children do start hating their dad. But on the 30th day, Alka receives a phone call that the children have been kidnapped and the kidnapper is demanding a sum of 25 Lakh rupees. Watch and find out who abducted the children, and whether or not Tiger had a hand in this.

Title: 905. Perico el de los palotes
description: A vedette and her lover end up in sleazy hotel with strange guests and lots of sexy situations.

Title: 906. El día que murió Pedro Infante
907. Mitsos, the Laughing Stock
description: Two childhood friends, Mitsos and Spinos, after failing as mobsters, open a marriage agency where they use techniques of deception that learned as kids from their mothers.

Title: 908. In the Jaws of Life
description: This movie, based in part on the popular novel, tells two tales about modern women. One is Stefica Cvek, average and lonely girl who is desperately trying to find the man of her dreams. The other story is about a woman director who is making the movie abozt Stefica and has the same problem.

Title: 909. Min fina el-Harami
description: Sherif returns from London with his girlfriend Sahar, he learns from her father that his identical twin brother Hassan is in prison for embezzling money from the company. Sherif visits Hassan who tells him that the money is hidden inside a bed and must find it as soon as possible.

Title: 910. Aysem
description: The love story of singer Ibrahim and his fan, Ayse.

Title: 911. Kaddish
description: From an early age Yossi Klein received a special education. He was prepared for another Holocaust. So were other children in Boro Park, the largest Orthodox survivor community in America, and this candid portrait of a young Jewish activist coming to terms with his father's traumatic history is as bracing as any fiction. Through his writing and activism, Yossi attempts to carry on the legacy of struggle passed on to him. A portrait emerges of a young man whose world view and personal outlook have been principally shaped by an event that took place before he was born.

Title: 912. Kotaro makari-toru!
description: Lewd, long-haired karate kid Kotaro Shindo spends his days causing amok at the prestigious Tsurugamine Academy, until the Disciplinary Committee decides enough is enough, and puts a bounty on his luscious locks.

Title: 916. Vojnici
description: A group of young men from different ethnic and social backgrounds are conscripted and must serve one year in the former Yugoslav army.

Title: 917. Hum Do Hamare Do
description: A hard working young man has to marry his 6 step sisters before he can think about getting married. The girl whom he tutors for living falls for him.She proposes him for marriage but he refuses citing above reason. this is over heard by his mother who poisons his step sisters to get him married and get rid of the problem. Watch how the movie evolves further.

Title: 918. Sosesc pasarile calatoare
description: Life in the romanian Danube Delta.

Title: 919. Sömnen
description: Tired of the touring life the rock star Tommy Cosmo cuts the strings of his guitar, empties his bank account, packs his revolver and takes off to find new values of life .

Title: 920. Homecoming
description: Coral, a Hong Kong woman tortured by city life, returns to her hometown to visit her two old friends. They all find that some precious things in life that disappear through the years can never be recovered.

Title: 921. The Bodyguard
description: An accountant ,in love with a girl who married a shady guy , becomes her bodyguard,without her knowing it.

Title: 923. Love Marriage
description: Rajesh Mehra lives a wealthy lifestyle with his mom, Sarita, and dad. His dad finalizes his marriage with Malti, who is the daughter of equally wealthy, Jagdish Kapoor. When Rajesh is told, he refuses to marry Malti as she is mentally unstable, an argument ensues, and Rajesh angrily leaves. He befriends a poultry farmer, Majid Kaliya, and lives rent-free in a room in his house. Rajesh takes to singing in a nightclub, meets with wealthy Ritu Mafatlal and both fall in love with each other. Mafatlal wants a rich groom for Ritu, and refuses to permit them to marry, so both elope, get married, and Malti moves in with Rajesh in Majid's room. This does not auger well with Majid's wife, Shabnam, who refuses to permit both to sleep together. Understanding their frustration, Majid gives them two passes to Mysore where they can spend time with each other - the only problem is that the passes are in the names of Kaushal and his sister Kamini Tiwari. Watch what happens when the duo end up at the Srivastav household, run by the Hitler-like Jailor, who had been fired from his job for letting Veeru and Jai (of Sholay) escape from his penitentiary, and are wooed by Murari and Leela Srivastav. Chaos ensues when Kaushal and Kamini decide to make a run with the jailer, and an odd assortment of characters - ranging from goons to black marketeers, giving chase to the hapless honeymooning couple

Title: 924. My First Wife
description: The film follows the dissolution of John and Helen's marriage and the aftermath.

Title: 925. Wreaths at the Foot of the Mountain
description: Follows a Red Army company from training, through combat in the Sino-Vietnamese War of 1979, and the aftermath of war, focusing on the anger created by nepotism among the Party elite.

Title: 926. John Wycliffe: The Morning Star
description: The story of 14th century John Wycliffe, AKA "The Morning Star of the Reformation", who was the first to translate the Bible into English.

Title: 928. Dharm Aur Qanoon
description: Justice Diwan lives in a palatial house with his wife, Sharda, and a son named Rajan. Diwan and Rajan do not get along and as a result, Rajan moves out and goes to live in a nearby slum area with two friends, Dr. Bashir Khan and his brother, Rahim. Bashir is in love with Reshma and hopes to marry her soon. Before that could happen, Dr. John, Bashir's senior, gets killed and the police find Bashir there with a knife in his hand. Bashir is arrested and taken to Court, where Justice Diwan finds him guilty and orders that he be hanged. Then a man named Bhurre gets killed, and the evidence points to Rajan, who is also arrested and produced before Justice Diwan, who also finds him guilty, and sentences him to death. Rahim then finds that his house had been burned down and is out on the street. Then the unexpected happens, Sharda is killed, and Diwan finds out that Rahim had been seen outside his house. Will Rahim be the next accused to be sentenced to death by Diwan?

Title: 929. Bertoldo, Bertoldino e Cacasenno
description: The story of a farmer that succeeded to contest the king Alboino in front of all his Royal court, in the Verona (Italy) of the 12th century, using just his cunning. He will risk several times his own life, but the king won't win any dispute at all.

Title: 930. Lev Tolstoy
description: The film concentrates on the late years of the life of the Russian writer Leo Tolstoy leading up to his death, telling about his disenchantment with the system and exploitation of the common people by the privileged classes.

Title: 931. Solo
description: A woman named Liz Brantley takes a three-legged solo flight and then her plane crashes.

Title: 932. Naan Mahaan Alla
description: An honest lawyer seeks revenge against a powerful don and decides to break the law after learning that his revenge cannot be fulfilled through due process of law. Whether he succeeds in his attempt ?

Title: 933. Tarang
description: Sethji is a widowed, a businessman and lives a comfortable life with his only daughter, Hansa, his son-in-law, Rahul, and a grandson, Munna. He has Rahul as his right-hand man, and a nephew named Dinesh who also assists in running the business. Petty rivalries and jealousies have grown in the family, and Sethji and Rahul feel that Dinesh is now trying to undermine the business. They would like to get rid of him, without attracting any attention to themselves. They do terminate Dinesh, but this affects Sethji's health, and he dies. Shortly thereafter, Hansa also dies, leaving Rahul to look after the business on his own. But there are many questions unanswered, like why was no one in attendance with the ailing Sethji; Hansa's death was a suicide, why was it covered up?; what of the affair that Rahul is having with Janki, their maidservant, who is full of venom against the family; and the involvement of Anita, Rahul's secretary, in his personal life. With the police getting involved, it is time for them to either come clean or go their separate ways.

Title: 934. Entre hierba, polvo y plomo
description: A Young boy takes after his father as a drug lord and rises to power ultimately resulting in a tragic feud between the two.

Title: 935. Kony
description: Kony is an inspirational story of a coach Khidda and his trainee Kony who fight all odds to achieve their aims.

Title: 936. The Chieftain
description: A love story about an actor, Arne Strømberg, which struggles with the changes between love and anger, and his roles as a macho man, family father and husband.

Title: 937. The Shepherd
description: Exciting "top gun" action and conflict in the lives of the men who push the edge of danger defending our skies.

Title: 938. Ninja Busters
description: Two pals tired of being losers and constantly rejected by women, decide to change their lives with learning martial arts. Through hard work they become kung fu masters, role models, find love, and become heroes after defeating an unruly gang of Ninjas for hire. Constant hilarity ensues.

Title: 939. Maybe It's Love
description: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

Title: 940. Tupac Amaru
description: Tupac Amaru is a 1984, Peruvian historical drama. The film depicts the life and struggle of legendary Andean warrior Tupac Amaru II, the native leader of a rebellion against the tyrannical spanish colonialism in Peru. The film also honors Tupac Amaru's Legacy as a symbol of resistance and empowerment for the indigenous people of the Americas.

Title: 941. Goldy: The Last of the Golden Bears
description: Ned Rivers loses his ranch to the railroad and returns to prospecting. In the wild he meets and befriends Jessie who has been wandering in the mountains since her father died. They take care of an orphaned grizzly cub, Goldy, a "Golden Bear," whose mother has been killed by a circus owner looking for a new circus attraction. When the circus owner, Boss Cooperman, arrives Ned and Jessie try to save her with the help of new friends.

Title: 942. Hayop sa sarap
description: A story of a Family that was been broken for the reason of the mother making an affair with her boss. Their Father became paralyze. The main character Irma Alegre decided to be a prostitute and so is her sister Angela Perez but their father suicides.

Title: 943. Asha Jyoti
description: Deepak, a young music player, learns that his late father has a second wife and daughter that no one knew existed. Soon, the same fate befalls Deepak when he falls for and marries Jyoti, a young artist and dancer who loves his music. But after Deepak mistakenly thinks Jyoti dies in an accident, he begins courting and marries Asha, a wealthy society girl. But when Jyoti unexpectedly returns months later with her newborn son, Deepak must try to find a way to deal with this predicament after Asha has a child of their own and begins taking dancing lessons at the dance school where Jyoti works.

Title: 944. Ohan
description: Although married to his second wife, an infertile ex-geisha, a man falls in love again with his ex-wife. He discovers hat he has a son from the first marriage, but that son drowns during a thunderstorm. A love-triangle showdown results.

Title: 945. Vidas errantes
description: Francisco and assistant Guillermo show films in mountain villages. Francisco uses profits to build a cinema on a town's outskirts. Their nearly finished cinema burns down due to their mentally disabled watchman's carelessness.

Title: 947. Era Soysa
description: Three middle aged men staying in a hostel.At a later stage, another tenant comes to stay in the hostel, where he falls in love with the eldest daughter of the hostel owner.The entire film was based on how the old three tenants trying their best to chase the new tenant and win the heart of owner's daughter.

Title: 948. Oru Kochu Swapnam
description: Sindhu, a teenage girl with strong sexual feelings and a desire to know more about it, meets a man with whom she falls in love. However, things become worse for her.

Title: 949. L'intrus
description: Pursued by the police, a man take refuge using menace in the appartment of a woman. Strangely, she didn't denounce him when she got the opportunity. Puzzled, he try to understand her secrets.

Title: 950. Lettow-Vorbeck: Der deutsch-ostafrikanische Imperativ
description: It's a biopic about "the lion of Africa" Paul von Lettow-Vorbeck and his time fighting in the German colonial regions of east Africa during the Great War.

Title: 951. De mica en mica s'omple la pica
description: A young man who likes the good life and easy money gets a proposition to represent a shady business company in Europe.

Title: 952. Kriminal
description: AN INNOCENT PROVINCIANO IS FRAMED UP THE POLICEMAN TO ADMIT TO COMMITTING SEVERAL CRIMES, ONE OF WHICH IS A SENSATIONAL NATIONAL SCANDAL.

Title: 955. The Scarecrow
description: Ismaeil is living with his son Ali and his daughter Sona. His wife passed away and his friends are insisting on him to get marry again. In school Ali's friend is complaining abut his step mother who beats him making Ali in deep fear of step mothers. Finally Ismaeil gets marry with Astar who is a teacher. Although she is very friendly and cares for the children Ali is resisting her and is aggressive with her. But little by little they get more close to each other.

Title: 956. Mayuri
description: The real story of a classical dancer, who loses her leg in an accident and fights her way back as a dancer.

Title: 958. Mr. Virgin
description: When a young man ignores a feng shui master's warning and decides to marry before turning 30, a series of mishaps begins to curse his life.

Title: 959. Lightning Fists of Shaolin
description: A Kung Fu master finds out that an opium den is destroying the lives of the town he lives in, and vows to put an end to the den, but first he must try to defeat the strongest enemy he has ever faced: his addiction to the drug itself.

Title: 960. Delitto in Formula Uno
description: While keeping an eye on his small time crook brother in law, Inspector Nico Giraldi gets involved in a murder case set in the world of Formula One racing. Giraldi is suspended for trying to cover up for his brother in law and becomes afraid his wife and son may be targeted next. Therefore he calls in the help of his childhood friend and chief informant, Venticello.

Title: 961. Access Code
description: A secret organisation gains control over the American nuclear weapons. A journalist ventures out to stop them.

Title: 962. Retén de Catia
description: Pedro Che is a carefree taxi driver who advises his friends Sebastián and Artemio, politically committed law students, to do like him. Following the kidnapping of Otamendi, a former corrupt official executed by a subversive command, Sebastían is unjustly detained by the police. Pedro and Sebastián's girlfriend break him out of jail with the help of a congressman. While they are celebrating their release, the police arrive and kill Artemio, who is implicated in the Otamendi case.

Title: 964. Dionysos
description: An American theatre professor travels to the Sorbonne in Paris to complete his doctoral research on the effectiveness of Greek comedy on morale and motivation of factory workers at the local automobile plant. Lunacy erupts, mayhem ensues.

Title: 965. Bucharest Identity Card
description: A young graduate tries to get a Bucharest ID card in comunist Romania, by pretending to marry a taxi driver.

Title: 966. White Dew
description: An old war veteran worries about his three sons - a smart one, a strong one and a kind one.

Title: 967. Basag ang pula
description: THIS SUSPENSE-THRILLER MOVE IS ABOUT A MAN WHO BECOMES PSYCHOLOGICALLY WARPED AFTER HE IS ABUSED AND BRUTALIZED,

Title: 968. Flight to Berlin
description: A woman is being taken from her German hotel to be interrogated by police agents.

Title: 970. Main Hoon Beauty Queen
description: An I.S.I. agent Sonia (Sapna) forces her rich industrialist lover Rohit (Amit Pachori) to organise a beauty pageant. Her ulterior motive is to send secret documents outside the country through the contest winner. Terror strikes as the beauty pageant gets underway and five finalist contestants are killed. Ravi (Sunny Tandon), a C.I.D. officer, starts investigations but falls in love with Kiran (Kanchan), the surviving contestant.

Title: 971. Parade of the Planets
description: In a surreal puzzler, this story of a fantasy lived by a disparate group of men captures the visual imagination with its images and leaves a large question mark in the meantime. A rare astronomical phenomenon - the parade of planets - has a peculiar effect on several of the men.

Title: 972. Manzil Manzil
description: Mr. Malhotra has an only daughter named Seema. He would like Seema to marry Pawan, the son of Gautam. Seema is receptive to this, and even arranges to meet with Pawan. While traveling alone one day in the country side, Seema meets up with Vijay, and both fall in love. Unknown to both, Mr. Malhotra has been approached by an international smuggler Niranjan Das, who is impersonating Mr. Malhotra's childhood friend, and has asked for Seema's hand in marriage for his son Roopesh. Seema subsequently has an accident and loses her memory. She is looked after by Gautam, who will not let anyone, including Vijay, to come anywhere near Seema. And even if Seema's memory does return, she will have to consent to marrying Roopesh, her father's choice.

Title: 973. Pyasa Shaitan
description: Shaitan (Joginder) needs to sacrifice seven young women so that he can attain immortality. He stumbles upon a man (Kamal Hassan), who had been worshiping Satan himself for many-many years. The man has grown old and also wishes to stay young forever. Shaitan signs a deal with him, granting temporary youth at first, that will become eternal after the sacrifice of the 7th and last young woman.

Title: 974. Alev Alev
description: Captain Murat and Alev are two lovers planning to get married. Murat takes a job at the powerful businessman Sahin's yacht and sets off for a long voyage. Sahin's sister Umran fancies him and Murat gives Alev up and marries Umran. Alev wants to take revenge by meeting Sahin. Sahin falls in love with her and now it is Murat's turn to be jealous.

Title: 975. Uindii
description: Kei is a professional motorcycle racer with a young daughter from an earlier marriage, and a busy schedule that takes him to West Berlin.

Title: 976. The Man of Earth
description: Sokol is a middle-aged Kosovar Albanian who, together with his family, emigrates from Kosovo to Turkey, and faces the foreign and unknown world. After some time he becomes homesick, eventually leaving his last will he gave to his son that when he dies, his bones will be returned to his native country. He dies near of a cliff at the Black Sea coast. In his native village, the news that Sokol has been returned from emigration are being spread.

Title: 977. Kung tawagin siya'y animal
description: A HUSBAND IS UNABLE TO REACT PROPERLY AGAINST HIS WIFE'S RAPE BY ANOTHER MAN, SOCIETY IS BY AND LARGE UNABLE TO PROTECT RAPE VICTIMS.

Title: 978. Baby Tsina
